4463531189.descriptionHtml:
Future Talent: Senior Software Engineer- Java (Talent Community – India)

Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad

Position Type: Future Opening – Talent Pipeline

The Opportunity

We are continuously searching for exceptional Java Engineers across India to help us build scalable, cloud-ready, high-performance platforms that power mission-critical financial systems.

While we may not have an immediate opening today, this dedicated Java Talent Pool helps us engage with strong engineers early.

By joining our engineering community, you'll gain access to insights into our architecture, engineering culture, and events, and be among the first to move directly into advanced interview stages when a matching role opens.

What You'll Do (When You Join Us)

As a Java Engineer, you will work on modern, enterprise-grade systems requiring deep technical expertise and strong engineering discipline.

Architect & Build

  • Design and develop scalable, cloud-native applications using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, REST APIs, and microservices architecture.
  • Build high-throughput backend services, event-driven applications, integration layers, and resilient distributed systems.
  • Develop secure, maintainable, and highly available applications leveraging modern Java ecosystem technologies.

Optimise & Enhance

  • Improve system performance through profiling, JVM tuning, memory optimisation, concurrency management, and API optimisation.
  • Implement clean architecture principles, design patterns, secure coding practices, and maintain high code quality standards.
  • Enhance application reliability through observability, monitoring, and automated testing.

Collaborate

  • Work in an Agile environment with Product Owners, Architects, SRE, QA, and Platform Engineering teams.
  • Participate in solution design discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and engineering best-practice initiatives.
  • Collaborate across teams to deliver scalable and resilient solutions aligned with business goals.

Mentor & Share

  • Guide junior engineers, contribute to engineering forums, and participate in internal tech talks and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Help drive engineering excellence through coaching, technical mentorship, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Desired Technical Expertise

We are interested in engineers with experience in some of the following technologies:

Core Technologies

  • Java 8/11/17+
  • Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security
  • RESTful APIs and Microservices
  • Hibernate/JPA
  • Maven or Gradle

Cloud & Modern Engineering

  • AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Event Streaming technologies such as Kafka
  • Distributed systems and cloud-native architectures

Databases & Data Technologies

  • SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL
  • NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis
  • Performance optimisation and database tuning

Engineering Practices

  • Test-Driven Development (TDD)
  • Unit, Integration, and Automation Testing
  • DevOps and Infrastructure as Code principles
  • Observability, monitoring, and production support

What You'll Bring

Build With Purpose

Start with why. Define the problem clearly. Deliver measurable outcomes.

Customer Driven

Work backwards from customer needs. Build for real-world use, with continuous feedback loops.

Technically Courageous

Tackle complex problems, push boundaries, learn from the best, and avoid mediocrity.

Learn and Be Curious

Develop a growth mindset. Continuously learn, experiment, and share knowledge.

Act as Owner

Operate as stewards of company resources. Prioritise long-term value.

Lead with Data

Use precise data to guide decisions, identify risks, and learn from outcomes.

Dive Deep

Stay close to the details, investigate discrepancies, and act swiftly to correct course.

Build Responsibly, Deliver Incrementally

Prioritise scalable, secure, reliable solutions and iterate using customer feedback.

Collaborate to Achieve

Communicate openly, work respectfully, and value how work is done as much as what is delivered.

How We Hire

Our process is skills-focused and structured to be fair and consistent.

For Java engineering roles, candidates typically complete an online coding assessment before participating in interviews exploring:

  • Core Java expertise
  • Data Structures & Algorithms
  • Object-Oriented Design
  • System Design and Architecture
  • Distributed Systems & Microservices
  • Problem Solving and Engineering Principles

Why Connect Now?

Skip the Line

Candidates in this talent community are prioritised for fast-track evaluation when a suitable Java role opens.

Exclusive Insights

Receive invites to architecture roundtables, engineering webinars, and technical roadmap previews.

Career Alignment

We only reach out for roles that fit your aspirations, whether that's backend engineering, distributed systems, cloud engineering, platform development, API engineering, or full-stack development.

How to Join

Upload your CV along with a short note about:

  • The type of Java engineering challenges you enjoy.
  • Your preferred technical areas: backend engineering, microservices, cloud platforms, distributed systems, API development, event-driven architectures, or platform engineering.

We will review your profile and connect for an informal conversation to better understand your interests and career aspirations.

Career Stage:

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

Experience implementing security using IAM, Identity Platform, VPCs, firewall rules, and secrets management via Secret Manager. Experience deploying Angular/React applications using Cloud Storage + Cloud CDN, including caching strategies and environment-based configuration. Summary

 Position Summary

Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.

Position Summary

As a Software Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, build, and enhance scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot technologies. You will contribute to enterprise-grade services, support quality delivery across the software development lifecycle, and help solve complex engineering challenges in a fast-paced project environment. This role offers the opportunity to deepen technical expertise, support innovation, and deliver impactful solutions for clients.

Work you'll do

As a Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining backend applications and microservices using Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, and related frameworks
  • Building and supporting RESTful application programming interfaces, integrating external services, and contributing to secure and scalable service design
  • Writing unit tests, troubleshooting defects, resolving performance issues, and supporting code quality across development and deployment activities
  • Working with relational and NoSQL databases, object-relational mapping tools, and cloud or container-based environments to support application delivery
  • Contributing to Agile delivery, technical documentation, automation, reusable assets, and continuous improvement initiatives across projects

The team

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST

Qualifications

 Required :

Core JAVA & Backend engineering:

  • 4 – 7 years of strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8+) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
  • Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
  • Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure, and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade-offs

Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:

  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture, with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
  • Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
  • Experience implementing security and cloud-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud (e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
  • Strong understanding of data persistence, including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization, complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
  • Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging, including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding

AWS

  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating full stack Java applications on AWS, leveraging cloud-native services and managed platforms.
  • Experience with EC2, ECS/EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, and AWS Lambda; ability to choose appropriate compute models for Java microservices and UI-backed APIs.
  • Experience exposing and managing RESTful APIs using API Gateway and Application Load Balancer (ALB); integration with Angular/React frontends.
  • Hands-on experience with RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and DynamoDB; data modeling, performance tuning, and transactional integrity.
  • Experience implementing security using IAM, Cognito, VPCs, security groups, and secrets management via Secrets Manager / Parameter Store.
  • Experience deploying Angular/React applications using S3 + CloudFront, including CDN caching, environment configuration, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with CI/CD using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins for Java and UI applications.
  • Experience with Docker and EKS (Kubernetes) for containerized Java microservices and frontend workloads.
  • Experience with CloudWatch, centralized logging, metrics, alerts, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to diagnose production issues, optimize performance, and ensure high availability with minimal handholding.

OR

GCP

  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating full stack Java applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), leveraging cloud-native services and managed platforms.
  • Experience with Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, and App Engine; ability to choose appropriate compute models for Java microservices and UI-backed APIs.
  • Experience exposing and managing RESTful APIs using Cloud Load Balancing and API Gateway / Apigee; integration with Angular/React frontends.
  • Hands-on experience with Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and Firestore / Bigtable; data modeling, performance tuning, and consistency considerations.
  • Experience implementing security using IAM, Identity Platform, VPCs, firewall rules, and secrets management via Secret Manager.
  • Experience deploying Angular/React applications using Cloud Storage + Cloud CDN, including caching strategies and environment-based configuration.
  • Experience with CI/CD using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins for Java and UI applications.
  • Experience with Docker and GKE (Kubernetes) for containerized Java microservices and frontend workloads.
  • Experience with Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, metrics, alerts, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to diagnose production issues, optimize performance, and ensure high availability with minimal handholding.

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
  • Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
  • Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
  • Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding

Preferred

 Certifications:

  • Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
  • Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner OR Cloud Digital Leader (CDL) (Foundational)
  • AWS Certified Developer – Associate OR Associate Cloud Engineer (ACE) (Associate)

Agile Development and Collaboration

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
  • Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
  • Awareness of any of the industry domains

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Benefits To Help You Thrive

Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

4464467514.descriptionHtml:
About AiDASH

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

The Role

As a SDE 2 Backend Engineer at AiDASH, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and optimising scalable backend systems that power our web and mobile app platform. You will own end-to-end feature development - translating product requirements into fully functional features that work well at scale by deploying robust backend microservices.

Collaborating closely with product managers, designers, web and mobile engineers, you will drive intuitive, data-driven applications while maintaining high availability, fault tolerance, and performance efficiency. Beyond development, you will champion code quality through reviews, refactoring, and best practices in security and performance optimisation.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Design, develop and deploy scalable distributed microservices.
  • Build scalable backend systems to support user-facing application workflows backed by automated pipelines and ML models.
  • Work with a variety of databases to efficiently write/read business intelligence and application workflow data to power high-performance backend systems.
  • Implement scalable and resilient distributed systems, ensuring fault tolerance and reliability.
  • Work on having enough testability and observability in place for running world-class production systems with near 100% system uptime.
  • Encourage and follow good coding practices via peer-to-peer code reviews.
  • Refactor services to improve code quality, runtime efficiency and resource optimisation.
  • Evolve AiDASH architecture as we continue to scale.
  • Monitor, analyse, and optimise system performance and resource utilisation.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in distributed systems technologies and methodologies.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience designing and building scalable, reusable products/components.
  • Demonstrated skills and understanding of microservices and systems design.
  • Sound with data structures and algorithms.
  • Sound understanding of Java and Spring Boot/ Python. Unit test cases, code quality and coverage.
  • An extremely good working knowledge of relational database systems (PostgreSQL/MySQL) or NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
  • Experience in designing, developing and maintaining RESTful APIs.
  • Operational experience with Docker, Kubernetes and AWS.
  • Knowledge of performance optimisation techniques, including load testing, profiling, and the ability to identify and resolve bottlenecks in backend systems.
  • Understanding of backend security principles, encryption, authentication, and authorisation.
  • They should be knowledgeable about common security vulnerabilities and compliance requirements, ensuring the systems they develop are secure and compliant with relevant regulations.
  • Understanding of distributed system architecture and design, including topics like load balancing, distributed databases, and microservices.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

Read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy-policy/

In this role, you will be at the forefront of building scalable, high-performance backend systems that support our SMS marketing automation platform. Your expertise will be instrumental in developing robust APIs, optimizing database performance, and integrating AI-assisted development tools to streamline our processes. This is an exciting opportunity for a developer passionate about innovation, automation, and AI technologies to contribute to a product that is redefining how businesses connect with their customers. The ideal candidate will thrive in a collaborative environment, possess strong technical skills, and have a keen interest in leveraging AI to enhance development workflows.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have between 4 to 7 years of backend development experience, demonstrating proficiency in Java and Spring Boot frameworks. A solid understanding of SQL and database optimization is essential, along with hands-on experience deploying and managing applications on AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, SNS, and SQS. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly using GitHub and Jenkins, is required. An interest or experience in AI-based development tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or Lovable will be considered a significant advantage. Excellent communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and experience working remotely are also key qualifications for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems using Java and Spring Boot, ensuring high performance and reliability.
  • Create and optimize database schemas, queries, and stored procedures to support platform functionalities.
  • Deploy, monitor, and manage applications on AWS cloud infrastructure, utilizing services like EC2, S3, RDS, SNS, and SQS.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to facilitate continuous integration, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, and deployment cycles, ensuring efficient workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including frontend developers, product managers, and AI specialists, to deliver impactful features and improvements.
  • Participate in code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing to uphold high coding standards and best practices.

Benefits

  • Work entirely remotely, providing flexibility and work-life balance.

4462522191.descriptionHtml:
• About QUIPU

Quipu is AI infrastructure for long-term memory, built for enterprises engineering complex systems—automotive, drug development, battery storage, and AI agents. We give every entity a single, audit-grade memory so teams can study cause and effect rather than guess at it.

That means vehicles with component-level traceability and failure prediction, accelerated drug development with fewer risky experiments, battery systems with trusted cell-ageing models, and agents with a shared persona that never resets.

  • Working Model — please read before applying

This is an on-site role at T-Hub, Hyderabad, on a 6-day working week for the first 9 months. We're building core infrastructure to a hard timeline, and we'd rather be upfront about the commitment than surprise you later. After the initial 9 months, the schedule moves to a standard 5-day week.

  • The Role

A Java backend engineer who thinks in systems, not just code. You'll own architecture decisions on core platform services—distributed microservices that handle graph storage, streaming ingestion, ETL pipelines, and semantic retrieval at scale—and you'll be expected to reason about trade-offs and failure modes before writing a line of code.

Experience required: 3–5 years of professional Java backend development. Applications with less than 3 years of professional experience will not be considered.

  • What You'll Do

•     Build and maintain Spring Boot microservices that form the core of a distributed graph memory platform

•     Own product architecture decisions: service boundaries, data flow, failure handling, and evolution of the platform as it scales

•     Design and implement security and access control in Java—authentication, authorization, multi-tenant data isolation, and secrets management (Keycloak, Vault, or comparable)

•     Work with event-driven and streaming architectures—Kafka-based pipelines, backpressure-aware stream processing, and actor-model concurrency

•     Build and operate ETL and data ingestion workflows: extraction, transformation, validation, and loading across heterogeneous sources

•     Model and query data across polyglot persistence: graph databases (Neo4j), distributed SQL (YugabyteDB), vector stores, and embedded key-value stores

•     Own features end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production debugging

•     Debug issues across the stack using logs, metrics, and traces

•     Participate in design reviews and explain your technical decisions with clear reasoning

  • Must-Have Skills

•     3–5 years of professional experience with Java and Spring Boot in production

•     Solid grounding in core Java: collections, concurrency, JVM fundamentals

•     Product architecture experience: designing service boundaries, reasoning about trade-offs, and owning systems beyond individual features

•     Working knowledge of security and access control in Java applications: authentication/authorization flows (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), role- and attribute-based access control, and secure API design

•     Hands-on production experience with Kafka or comparable event-streaming platforms

•     Experience building or operating ETL / data pipeline processes

•     Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency models, partitioning, idempotency, retries, backpressure, and failure handling

•     Strong SQL skills and familiarity with at least one relational database

•     Experience with at least one NoSQL or graph database

•     Comfort reading logs, metrics, and traces to find root causes in running services

•     Ability to reason about a system before coding it—design rationale, not just working code

•     Available to work on-site in Hyderabad, 6 days a week for the first 9 months

  • Strong Plus

•     Keycloak, HashiCorp Vault, or hands-on IAM integration in production

•     Experience with Akka or Apache Pekko (actors, streams, cluster)

•     Graph databases (Neo4j, Cypher) or graph data modeling

•     Distributed SQL databases (YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, Spanner-class systems)

•     Vector databases and semantic search pipelines (Milvus, pgvector, etc.)

•     Python (FastAPI) for building service sidecars

•     Exposure to LLM-integrated systems: prompt pipelines, extraction workflows, RAG architectures

•     Infrastructure familiarity: Jenkins, Docker, containerized deployments on Linux

  • Who You Are

•     You ask, "Why is the system shaped this way?" before asking, "What do I build?"

•     You're comfortable with ambiguity and small-team ownership—no hand-holding, no rigid specs

•     You debug from first principles and write down what you learn

•     You communicate trade-offs clearly and can disagree constructively in design discussions

  • What We Offer

•     Direct ownership of core infrastructure on a small team—your work ships and matters immediately

•     Deep, unusual technical problems: bitemporal modeling, graph traversal at scale, streaming knowledge extraction

•     Close mentorship from technical leadership on architecture and systems design

4464923160.descriptionHtml:
Join the Future of Supply Chain Intelligence — Powered by Agentic AI

At Resilinc, we’re pioneering intelligent, autonomous systems that redefine supply chain risk management. Our agentic AI helps global enterprises predict disruptions, assess impact, and act in real time — before operations are affected. Named a 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader, we’re trusted by top companies in life sciences & pharma, aerospace & defense, high tech, and automotive to protect what matters most. Be part of a team that's redefining resilience on a global scale.

But the real power behind Resilinc? Our people. We’re a fully remote, mission-led team making sure life-saving products and critical goods get where they’re needed, fast. We offer the chance to do meaningful work in a collaborative, empowering culture—where you can be an agent of change. Join us to tackle critical global challenges through high-impact work that matters.

Check out this blog to learn more about how we are impacting the world's most critical supply chains. Global Supply Chain Risks 2026: Act Faster | TEC

Resilinc | Innovation with Purpose. Intelligence with Impact.

What You Will Do

Software Development:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot
  • Build clean, reusable, production-quality code and contribute to technical design and architecture decisions


Microservices & APIs:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and microservices with a focus on high availability, scalability, resilience, and fault tolerance
  • Implement secure service-to-service integrations, authentication, authorization, and API security best practices


Database & Data Access:

  • Work extensively with PostgreSQL and other relational databases; design efficient schemas and data-access solutions
  • Write and optimize complex SQL, including joins, subqueries, set operations, and aggregate functions, and work with JPA/Hibernate


Cloud & Infrastructure:

  • Deploy, manage, and scale cloud-native applications in Azure environments using modern CI/CD practices
  • Work with Docker and Kubernetes for containerized application deployment, orchestration, and operational readiness


Distributed Systems & Engineering Quality:

  • Apply distributed-systems concepts, multithreading, concurrency, caching, resilience, retry, and fault-tolerance patterns where appropriate
  • Develop unit and integration tests using JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, or similar tools; participate actively in code reviews


Collaboration & Leadership:

  • Partner with product managers, architects, QA, DevOps, and other engineers to plan and deliver high-quality features and services
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, provide constructive technical guidance, and help raise engineering standards across the team


Troubleshooting & Performance:

  • Diagnose complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes


Continuous Improvement:

  • Proactively improve application performance, scalability, observability, security, development processes, and code quality
  • Stay current with relevant technologies and evaluate practical improvements to the engineering ecosystem


What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5-8+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and backend engineering
  • Strong experience designing REST APIs, microservices, and distributed applications using object-oriented design, SOLID principles, and common design patterns
  • Strong RDBMS and PostgreSQL experience, including 3+ years of hands-on work with complex SQL queries, subqueries, joins, set operations, aggregate functions, schema design, and query optimization
  • Hands-on experience with JPA/Hibernate, Git, Maven or Gradle, and automated testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito
  • Experience with Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines; familiarity with messaging or event-streaming platforms such as Kafka is desirable
  • Strong debugging, analytical, problem-solving, and performance-tuning skills, with a solid understanding of secure backend development
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in Agile/Scrum teams
  • Ability to take ownership, manage changing priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced product engineering environment


What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience building high-volume, highly available SaaS or enterprise platforms
  • Experience with Apache Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL
  • Experience with Spark will be valuable
  • Knowledge of OAuth 2.0, JWT, observability tools, and DevOps practices
  • Familiarity with performance testing, infrastructure as code, Domain-Driven Design, or front-end technologies such as Angular or React


What's in it for you?

At Resilinc, we’re fully remote, with plenty of opportunities to connect in person. We provide a culture where ownership, purpose, technical growth and a voice in shaping impactful technology are at our core. Oh, and the perks? Full-stack benefits for health, wealth and wellbeing to keep you thriving. Check in with your talent acquisition contact for a location-specific FAQ.

4463485183.descriptionHtml:
Identifier: INST-SSD-FO

Location: Trivandrum


For our office in Trivandrum, dSPACE is looking for creative and motivated professionals. You will be a key member of the agile team responsible for the continuous development and operation of our companywide D365‑FO solution across the dSPACE Group.


We are offering a position as a Senior Software Developer for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. In this role, you will leverage your strong software development background and hands-on experience with Dynamics 365-FO to contribute across the entire software development lifecycle—from requirements analysis and solution design to implementation, deployment, and ongoing support. Beyond development, you will take technical ownership within the team, mentor junior developers, and collaborate closely with Product Owners, architects, and other stakeholders.


Great colleagues are waiting for you, who are eager to shape the mobility of tomorrow together with you and to live and improve the agile processes day by day. During an intensive induction period, your colleagues will support you to familiarize you with our products.


Your Tasks


  • You actively participate in an Agile Scrum team, including Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives, and Daily Stand-ups
  • You collaborate with architects to ensure compliance with architecture, security, and governance standards
  • You analyze business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions
  • You design, develop, and maintain customizations and extensions for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
  • You implement user stories and technical tasks from a prioritized backlog in Azure DevOps
  • You refactor and optimize existing X++ implementations
  • You ensure high code quality, performance, and maintainability through code reviews and adherence to best practices
  • You provide technical guidance and mentoring within the development team


Your Profile


  • You hold an MCA, B.Tech, or M.Tech degree in Computer Science
  • You have a minimum of 5 years of prior Dynamics AX and D365 F&O experience
  • You demonstrate strong technical skills in X++ Development and D365 F&O extension model
  • You possess solid working knowledge of LCS, Azure DevOps and Visual Studio
  • You have a solid foundation in SQL Server and database design principles
  • You are experienced in building SSRS & X++ Reports
  • You are well-versed in Microsoft DevOps and release pipeline concepts
  • You are self-motivated, with the ability to deliver tasks on time and work effectively both independently and as part of a team


What We Offer


  • A crucial role in a young, dynamic, and fast-growing team
  • A work environment that fosters trust, respect, and feedback
  • An onboarding buddy to integrate you smoothly into our team
  • Productivity and improvement time between the development sprints
  • A mentor helping you with your personal goals, technical progress in general and your software engineering skills in particular


About us

dSPACE is a market innovator and leader in providing solutions and systems for embedded controller software development in Automotive, Aerospace and Manufacturing industries. Founded in Germany in 1988, dSPACE employs over 2,600 dedicated people worldwide, who are committed to making the embedded controls software development process more efficient through innovative tools and services.


Working at dSPACE means taking on challenging and varied tasks in a promising and exciting industry. With us, you have responsibility and can shape your personal career. A collegial and cooperative approach is as natural for us as the continuous development of your expertise.


If you are ready to join our highly successful international team and take on the challenge of creating yet another success story in India – send us your application including motivational letter and CV at career.tvm@dspace.in indicating your earliest possible entry date.

4463952516.descriptionHtml:
About Company:


Kinexcs is an AI-driven digital health platform and wearables company with a mission to enable and empower people for mobility and a better quality of life. It is focused on reducing the burden of musculoskeletal conditions, which affects about 25% of the world's population. Their 1st product, KIMIA Recover, a continuous monitoring device for the knee joint, has obtained CE marking and HSA approval and booked revenues from large implant companies and hospitals. It has recently won the Innomatch grant by the Temasek Foundation (one of the 6 among 256 companies across 32 countries), and is currently deployed in some of the largest public hospitals in Singapore. KIMIA Recover is a comprehensive recovery management solution that provides a reduction in the number of hospital visits and complications. The product was also the National Winner and International Top 20 of the prestigious James Dyson Award 2020 and has gained traction with major public hospitals and orthopaedic clinics. Their digital therapy platform, consisting of KIMIA Assess and KIMIA Move products, uses artificial intelligence technology for digital MSK assessment and therapy. This platform is capable of providing pre-consultation assessments and real-time exercise guidance and feedback to musculoskeletal patients and is being adopted by some of the largest private healthcare providers in the region, along with large corporate players.


About the Role:


Are you a hands-on Backend Developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems.

We are looking for a Backend Developer with strong hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, databases, and AWS.

The ideal candidate will be actively involved in software development while driving engineering best practices and maintaining the code quality.


You will work closely with Tech Lead, Architects, QA and DevOps and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, secure and maintainable backend solutions.


What We're Looking For:


We’re seeking professionals with 3–6 years of software development experience, strong backend engineering expertise and experience.


Required Technical Skills:


Strong hands-on experience with Java and object-oriented programming.

Strong experience with Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem.

Hands-on experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend services.

Strong practical experience with Microservices architecture.

Good understanding of microservices concepts including service decomposition, inter-service communication, scalability, resiliency and fault tolerance.

Strong knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle or similar.

Working experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis or similar.

Strong working knowledge of AWS cloud services.

Good understanding of system design and scalable backend architectures.

Strong understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, clean code and coding standards.

Experience with unit testing, integration testing, debugging and code reviews.

Good understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.

Experience working with Git and modern software development practices.

Ability to troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and identify root causes.


Key Responsibilities As a Backend Developer, you will:


Working with development of scalable Java and Spring Boot backend applications.

Develop, maintain microservices and REST APIs.

Participate actively in coding, debugging, technical discussions and code reviews.

Ensure adherence to coding standards, design principles, testing practices and engineering best practices.

Review code and provide constructive technical feedback to team members.

Collaborate with Tech Lead, Architects, QA, DevOps and other stakeholders.

Troubleshoot production issues and drive root-cause analysis and permanent fixes.

Contribute to improving development processes, automation, quality and engineering productivity.


Ideal Candidate:

You would be a great fit if you:

Have 3–6 years of professional software development experience.

Have strong hands-on expertise in Java and Spring Boot.

Have solid experience building and maintaining REST APIs and Microservices.

Have experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.

Have practical experience with AWS.

Have strong problem-solving, analytical and debugging skills.

Have a good understanding of system design and scalable architectures.

Take ownership of delivering high-quality, secure, scalable and maintainable software.

Have React.js or Vue.js experience as an additional advantage.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, and QA) to conceptualize, design, and deliver high-impact features.
  • Architect and build scalable, high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Produce clean, maintainable, and well-documented code with a strong emphasis on reliability and testability.
  • Seamlessly integrate third-party services and APIs, ensuring robust error handling and graceful degradation.
  • Continuously enhance system performance and developer experience through thoughtful automation and refactoring.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex issues across the stack while proactively identifying opportunities for technical improvements.
  • Actively contribute to code reviews and architecture discussions, promoting engineering best practices across the team.
  • Maintain clear documentation of technical decisions, systems, and processes to support transparency and long-term scalability.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands-on professional experience in software engineering, with a strong emphasis on backend development.
  • Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, with a solid grasp of modern backend architecture and engineering best practices.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and scaling web services, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Working knowledge of Agile development methodologies and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency with relational databases and ORM frameworks (e.g., Hibernate).
  • Exposure to frontend technologies such as AngularJS or React is a plus.
  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting abilities, with a structured approach to problem-solving.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-first mindset.

Our Tech Stack

As part of our engineering team, you’ll work with modern technologies and tools that enable us to build scalable, reliable, and high-performing systems. Some of the technologies you’ll be hands-on with include

  • Java (latest versions): Powers our core backend systems with a strong emphasis on performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Spring & Spring Boot: Enables the development of modular, production-ready microservices with robust dependency management.
  • Docker & Kubernetes: Supports containerized deployments and orchestration, ensuring consistent and scalable environments across development, staging, and production.
  • PostgreSQL & DynamoDB: Leverages both relational and NoSQL databases to efficiently manage structured data and dynamic scaling requirements.
  • Elasticsearch: Delivers fast, flexible full-text search and real-time analytics across large datasets.
  • AWS Cloud Infrastructure: Facilitates cloud-native deployment and management of microservices designed for high availability and global scalability.

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, paid leave, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

Our interview process is designed to be thoughtful, transparent, and candidate-friendly, allowing you to showcase your strengths while getting to know us better:

  • Initial Conversation: A brief introductory call with our recruiter to learn more about your background, career goals, and to share insights about the role and our team.
  • Technical Assessment: A practical, take-home coding exercise that reflects real-world challenges. You'll have ample time to complete this in your own environment
  • Deep Dive Technical Interview: A focused session with our Engineering Team, where we'll explore system design, architecture, and problem-solving approaches.
  • Final Interview: A combined technical and behavioural conversation with a member of our Executive Team, aimed at understanding your alignment with our values, vision, and culture

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

4464872653.descriptionHtml:
Job Description: Senior Java Full Stack Developer (AI)

· Role: Senior Java Full Stack Developer (AI)

· Job Location: Remote (India)

· Experience: 6-10 years



About the Role

We are looking for a talented Java Full Stack Developer with 6-10 years of experience in designing and developing scalable enterprise applications using Java and Spring Boot. The ideal candidate should have exposure to modern frontend technologies, preferably React, along with practical experience leveraging AI tools and frameworks to build intelligent applications and accelerate software development.


You will work on developing cloud-native applications that incorporate AI-powered capabilities, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to building next-generation AI-enabled products.


Key Responsibilities: 


· Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Java and Spring Boot.

· Develop secure and high-performance REST APIs and microservices.

· Build and maintain responsive user interfaces using React.js or other modern frontend technologies, as required.

· Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and code quality.

· Develop AI-powered applications, intelligent workflows, AI agents, and automation solutions using modern AI frameworks and services.

· Collaborate with architects, product managers, designers, and QA teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

· Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-tested code following industry best practices.

· Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, and production support.

· Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, software engineering practices, and cloud-native development.

Technical Skills Required


· Strong proficiency in Java with Spring Boot for developing scalable enterprise applications.

· Experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and Microservices.

· Good understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.

· Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

· Experience using AI tools, frameworks, and coding assistants to design, develop, test, and accelerate software development.

· Exposure to building AI-powered applications, AI agents, or intelligent automation workflows.

· Familiarity with one or more of the following: LLMs, Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI), and AI APIs.

· Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.


Additional Preferred Skills

· Python

· Kotlin knowledge will be a big plus

· Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

· Vector Databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Azure AI Search)

· Spring AI, LangChain, LangGraph

· Kafka or RabbitMQ

· Redis

· Agentic AI concepts

Qualifications

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

· 6+ years of professional software development experience.

· Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Integers.Ai is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

4464863355.descriptionHtml:
Summary

 Position Summary

  • Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.

Position Summary

 Role: Software Engineer III

Work you'll do

As a Software Engineer III on the AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend applications and application programming interfaces using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and delivery teams to analyze requirements, support solution design, and deliver features across the software development lifecycle.
  • Build and support cloud-based solutions using Amazon Web Services services and containerized deployment environments.
  • Participate in Agile delivery activities, including sprint planning, estimation, retrospectives, and peer reviews to support quality and timely delivery.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, performance improvement, defect resolution, and engineering process enhancement across project work.

The team

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST or 2 PM to 11 PM IST

Qualifications

Education: BE/Btech

Required:

  • 7-9 years of experience in Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition, Spring Boot, and microservices development.
  • Core JAVA & Backend engineering:
  • Strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8+) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
  • Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
  • Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure, and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade-offs
  • Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture, with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
  • Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
  • Experience implementing security and cloud-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud (e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
  • Strong understanding of data persistence, including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization, complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
  • Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging, including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
  • AWS Cloud
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating full stack Java applications on AWS, leveraging cloud-native services and managed platforms.
  • Experience with EC2, ECS/EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, and AWS Lambda; ability to choose appropriate compute models for Java microservices and UI-backed APIs.
  • Experience exposing and managing RESTful APIs using API Gateway and Application Load Balancer (ALB); integration with Angular/React frontends.
  • Hands-on experience with RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and DynamoDB; data modeling, performance tuning, and transactional integrity.
  • Experience implementing security using IAM, Cognito, VPCs, security groups, and secrets management via Secrets Manager / Parameter Store.
  • Experience deploying Angular/React applications using S3 + CloudFront, including CDN caching, environment configuration, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with CI/CD using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins for Java and UI applications.
  • Experience with Docker and EKS (Kubernetes) for containerized Java microservices and frontend workloads.
  • Experience with CloudWatch, centralized logging, metrics, alerts, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to diagnose production issues, optimize performance, and ensure high availability with minimal handholding.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
  • Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
  • Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
  • Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding
  • Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  • Certification (JAVA):
  • Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
  • Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Certification (AWS):
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
  • AWS Certified Developer - Associate
  • Agile Development and Collaboration
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
  • Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
  • Awareness of any of the industry domains
  • Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Spring Security, Spring Cloud, transaction management, and asynchronous communication patterns.
  • Experience with SOAP services, external application programming interface integrations, and distributed service design.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning concepts, including natural language processing, deep learning, or computer vision.
  • Experience with Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or natural language processing libraries.

#AIE2027

Our purpose

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

4464857435.descriptionHtml:
Summary

 Position Summary

  • Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.

Position Summary

 Role: Software Engineer III

Work you'll do

As a Software Engineer III on the AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend applications and application programming interfaces using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and delivery teams to analyze requirements, support solution design, and deliver features across the software development lifecycle.
  • Build and support cloud-based solutions using Amazon Web Services services and containerized deployment environments.
  • Participate in Agile delivery activities, including sprint planning, estimation, retrospectives, and peer reviews to support quality and timely delivery.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, performance improvement, defect resolution, and engineering process enhancement across project work.

The team

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST or 2 PM to 11 PM IST

Qualifications

Education: BE/Btech

Required:

  • 7-9 years of experience in Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition, Spring Boot, and microservices development.
  • Core JAVA & Backend engineering:
  • Strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8+) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
  • Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
  • Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure, and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade-offs
  • Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture, with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
  • Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
  • Experience implementing security and cloud-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud (e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
  • Strong understanding of data persistence, including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization, complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
  • Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging, including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
  • AWS Cloud
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating full stack Java applications on AWS, leveraging cloud-native services and managed platforms.
  • Experience with EC2, ECS/EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, and AWS Lambda; ability to choose appropriate compute models for Java microservices and UI-backed APIs.
  • Experience exposing and managing RESTful APIs using API Gateway and Application Load Balancer (ALB); integration with Angular/React frontends.
  • Hands-on experience with RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and DynamoDB; data modeling, performance tuning, and transactional integrity.
  • Experience implementing security using IAM, Cognito, VPCs, security groups, and secrets management via Secrets Manager / Parameter Store.
  • Experience deploying Angular/React applications using S3 + CloudFront, including CDN caching, environment configuration, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with CI/CD using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins for Java and UI applications.
  • Experience with Docker and EKS (Kubernetes) for containerized Java microservices and frontend workloads.
  • Experience with CloudWatch, centralized logging, metrics, alerts, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to diagnose production issues, optimize performance, and ensure high availability with minimal handholding.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
  • Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
  • Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
  • Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding
  • Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  • Certification (JAVA):
  • Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
  • Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Certification (AWS):
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
  • AWS Certified Developer - Associate
  • Agile Development and Collaboration
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
  • Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
  • Awareness of any of the industry domains
  • Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Spring Security, Spring Cloud, transaction management, and asynchronous communication patterns.
  • Experience with SOAP services, external application programming interface integrations, and distributed service design.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning concepts, including natural language processing, deep learning, or computer vision.
  • Experience with Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or natural language processing libraries.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a backend focus, building services in Java and Spring Boot alongside an Angular frontend. This person is comfortable moving database-centric designs toward domain-driven structures and building RESTful APIs with clean, modern patterns. Strong SQL and relational database skills are essential.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Spend the majority of your time (approx. 70-80%) designing and implementing robust backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
- Build and maintain the supporting Angular frontend, ensuring a seamless connection between the UI and your backend logic.
- Lead the transition from traditional database-centric designs toward a domain-driven structure (DDD).
- Architect RESTful APIs that prioritize proper HTTP verbs and clean, scalable patterns over legacy RPC styles.
- Work within cross-functional squads to deliver high-quality features while maintaining the "cohesive and proactive" spirit of the team.

MUST HAVES
- Advanced proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and a solid working knowledge of Angular, of at least 4 years.
- A strong grasp of Object-Oriented Design (OOD) and software design patterns.
- Deep experience building and consuming RESTful services with a clear understanding of standard API protocols.
- Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and JPA/Hibernate. Candidates must have robust transactional database experience (Oracle, Postgres), strong SQL skills to navigate and optimize very complex SQL in KALC, and a thorough understanding of enterprise-level, high-transactional platforms. Lacking this specific database proficiency will be a direct reason for rejection.
- A passion for server-side logic, performance, and architecture.
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Experience working with spec-driven development or related (AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle).
- Previous experience in the Loyalty or Fintech sectors.
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and containerization (Docker).
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
- Experience refactoring legacy structures into modern, domain-driven architectures.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Remote work & Local connection: Work where you feel most productive and connect with your team in periodic meet-ups to strengthen your network and connect with other top experts.
- Legal presence in India: We ensure full local compliance with a structured, secure work environment tailored to Indian regulations.
- Competitive Compensation in INR: Fair compensation in INR with dedicated budgets for your personal growth, education, and wellness.
- Innovative Projects: Leverage the latest tech and create cutting-edge solutions for world-recognized clients and the hottest startups.

4463017818.descriptionHtml:
About the Role:


We are looking for a skilled Java Developer with at least 3 years of experience in backend development to join our fast-paced startup. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Spring Boot, NoSQL/MongoDB, and an understanding of SQL databases.


As a core member of our engineering team, you will thrive in a high-velocity environment, championing lean development and rapid MVP rollouts. A background in product engineering, familiarity with GCP cloud services, and a strong understanding of AI-driven development and the AI Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) are highly desirable.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Embrace a startup mindset by driving rapid prototyping, MVP delivery, and iterating quickly based on lean development principles.
  • Integrate AI-based engineering practices into the SDLC, leveraging AI tools to accelerate development and building intelligent, AI-integrated product features.
  • Implement and manage databases including NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB), PostgreSQL, and Clickhouse.
  • Champion Test-Driven Development (TDD), writing clean, testable, and efficient code backed by robust test suites using JUnit.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver high-quality software solutions with agility and speed.
  • Participate in code reviews, debugging, and performance tuning.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and system design discussions.
  • Maintain high standards of software quality within the team


Requirements:


  • 3+ years of professional experience in Java development.
  • Proficiency in the Spring Boot framework.
  • Strong experience with NoSQL and PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarity with Clickhouse databases.
  • Proven experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) and testing frameworks like JUnit.
  • Strong understanding of AI-based engineering aspects, including building AI-integrated workflows, interacting with LLMs, or leveraging AI coding tools to optimize the SDLC.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment with a strong bias for action.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms like GCP is a plus.
  • Solid foundation in computer science principles and product engineering practices.
  • Good communication skills and a proactive attitude towards problem-solving


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience in highly agile development environments using lean methodologies.
  • Familiarity with DevOps tools, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and automated testing workflows.
  • Knowledge of containerization tools like Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to mentor and guide junior developers.
  • Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering business value.
  • Self-motivated, collaborative, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to engineering excellence.

You’ll work across the full software development lifecycle, building critical applications, APIs, interfaces, and web services. The role combines strong backend engineering with modern frontend development using Vue 3. You’ll leverage AWS and Java-based technologies to create reliable, scalable, and high-performing solutions. You’ll also contribute to technical decision-making, including the evaluation of algorithms and software architecture approaches. With opportunities to lead complex initiatives or work independently, this role is suited to a senior engineer who thrives in challenging technical environments.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver robust solutions using modern cloud-based technologies.
  • Build highly complex and business-critical applications, software interfaces, APIs, and web services.
  • Develop scalable frontend experiences using Vue 3 and robust backend services using Java.
  • Evaluate the need for new algorithms, models, and technical approaches within enterprise software applications.
  • Provide technical guidance and recommendations to stakeholders and management on complex engineering challenges.
  • Independently investigate and resolve highly sensitive or critical issues throughout the complete software development lifecycle.
  • Lead technical initiatives and contribute to the delivery of complex projects, either independently or as part of a development team.
  • Ensure proposed software solutions meet technical specifications, quality standards, scalability requirements, and business objectives.

Requirements

  • 9+ years of professional software development experience, ideally in full-stack or enterprise application development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and Vue 3.
  • Strong understanding of modern full-stack application architecture and software development practices.
  • Practical experience designing and developing complex applications, APIs, interfaces, and web services.
  • Strong experience working with AWS and cloud-based application development.
  • Experience with Spring Boot is highly desirable.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical problems and independently develop effective solutions.
  • Strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle, from design and development through deployment, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a technical team.
  • Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and technical leadership skills.
  • Comfortable taking ownership of critical systems and making sound technical decisions in complex environments.

Benefits

  • Salary: INR 20–40 LPA, depending on experience and fit.
