Job Description

Job Overview:

The Lead Engineer will be responsible for implementing and maintaining Majesco Insurance products that uses ICD/ICM toolkit framework as the development framework. ICD/ICM is a Majesco's proprietary framework. Majesco has built this framework in house, using Java and many open-source software. The ICD/ICM is a low code development platform which provides environment for developers to create application software through graphical user interfaces and configuration instead of traditional computer programming.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Work in Agile based self-organized team environment
  • Learn Majesco's Java based development framework and its capabilities
  • Work with Product solution architect and Business Analysts to make sure that the configuration and custom components meet application requirements and performance goals.
  • Designing of functional modules
  • Developing YAWL flows, defining and updating Object Models and Mappings
  • Writing and defining Rules in Rules Engine
  • Developing new APIs and new interfaces
  • Develop database scripting and perform data verifications

Technical Skills

Essential skills

  • Hands-on experience in designing and developing applications using Java EE platforms
  • 5-8 years of experience on JAVA
  • Object Oriented analysis and design using common design pattens
  • Good knowledge of Relational Databases, SQL and ORM technologies (JPA2, Hibenate)
  • Experience in developing web applications using at least one popular web framework
  • Experience in SOAP / RESTFul webservices
  • Experience with test-driven development
  • Good understanding of HTML5 and CSS3 and Web Standards

Behavioral Skills:

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Leading and building a strong technical team in .net technology.
  • Assertive communication skills
  • Driving change
  • Flexibility

Domain Exposure

  • Insurance Domain experience preferred

Agile/Scrum Exposure

  • Good working knowledge of Agile methodologies.

4466834733.descriptionHtml:
Job Description – Senior Java & Node.js Backend Developer

Experience: 6–10 Years

Location: Remote

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Asset Collection: Mumbai / Chennai / Bangalore / Gurgaon

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Java & Node.js Backend Developer with 8–10 years of strong hands-on experience in backend application development, microservices architecture, API development, event-driven systems, and cloud technologies.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Microservices, Kafka, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, AWS, Docker, OpenShift, Jenkins, and API security. Experience with communication platforms such as Email and SMS is an added advantage.

The candidate should also demonstrate practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code Assist, along with an understanding of responsible AI usage, privacy, code provenance, prompting practices, and development guardrails.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance highly scalable backend services and microservices using Java 8–21, Spring Boot, and Node.js v16/v22.
  • Design and implement secure, scalable, and high-performance REST APIs, including API gateway management using Apigee.
  • Develop and manage event-driven and asynchronous architectures using Apache Kafka, AWS MSK, or equivalent messaging platforms.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain database objects, queries, stored procedures, and performance-critical operations using PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
  • Manage and enhance existing Email and SMS middleware platforms, including support, development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Work with communication platforms such as SparkPost, Twilio, Syniverse, or equivalent technologies.
  • Build and maintain containerized applications using Docker and deploy/manage workloads on OpenShift / ROSA.
  • Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Git.
  • Monitor application health, performance, availability, and logs using New Relic and ELK Stack.
  • Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, API security, and other security best practices.
  • Collaborate with internal application teams, vendors, architects, business stakeholders, and other technical teams.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive performance and reliability improvements.
  • Contribute to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively while following organizational policies related to privacy, security, prompt patterns, code provenance, limitations, and governance.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to team members and contribute to a collaborative engineering environment.

Required Technical Skills

Must-Have Keywords:

  • Java 8–21
  • Spring Boot
  • Microservices
  • Node.js v16/v22
  • Apache Kafka / AWS MSK
  • PostgreSQL
  • SQL Server
  • REST APIs
  • Apigee
  • Docker
  • OpenShift / ROSA
  • Jenkins
  • Git
  • New Relic
  • ELK Stack
  • HTML5
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • AWS
  • AI-Assisted Development Tools – Claude Code Assist / GitHub Copilot

Good to Have

  • Experience with SparkPost, Twilio, Syniverse, or similar Email/SMS communication platforms.
  • Experience working on high-volume messaging and communication middleware platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native application development and AWS services.
  • Experience with production support, application performance optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of secure software development practices and API governance.

AI-Assisted Development Experience

Candidates should have demonstrated experience incorporating AI-assisted development tools into their daily engineering workflows, including:

  • GitHub Copilot, Claude Code Assist, or equivalent AI coding assistants.
  • Effective prompt patterns for software development and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of AI-generated code limitations and validation requirements.
  • Awareness of privacy, security, governance, and code-provenance considerations.
  • Ability to review, test, validate, and appropriately govern AI-generated code.

4467967546.descriptionHtml:
Senior Full Stack Engineer


Experience Level: 8 – 12 Years

Location: Kochi, India

Primary Domain: Backend, Microservices & Cloud

Secondary Focus: Frontend Integration (Full Stack)

Salary Range : INR 9,00,000/- to 11,00,000/- LPA


Ownership & Ownership Mindset Requirement


We are seeking a proactive technical professional who acts as a true owner of their deliverables. In this role, you will hold end-to-end accountability for designing, building, deploying, and maintaining high-performance microservices. You are expected to take complete responsibility for architectural clarity, code quality, automated testing, system resilience, and cloud operations.


Role Overview


As an Associate Full Stack Engineer (Backend/Cloud Focus), you will serve as a core technical driver for project's backend engine while remaining cross-functional across the entire stack. You will architect robust RESTful APIs, manage cloud services, optimize streaming data workflows, and ensure seamless delivery from development through production.


Key Responsibilities


· Core Backend Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and production-ready microservices using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Hibernate/JPA.

· Cloud & Infrastructure: Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/ Azure cloud services. Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure workflows.

· Data Management & Persistence: Optimize database interactions across relational databases (PostgreSQL/ Oracle) and NoSQL stores. Implement effective caching strategies (Redis) and asynchronous messaging queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ).

· Cross-Functional Full-Stack Integration: Collaborate closely with frontend teams to define clean API contracts, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and integrate frontend components (Angular/TypeScript) whenever end-to-end feature delivery requires cross-functional hands-on contribution.

· System Reliability & Ownership: Take full accountability for monitoring, bug resolution, operational performance, unit/integration testing (JUnit, Mockito), and code quality reviews.


Required Technical Qualifications & Experience


· Experience: 8 to 12 years of hands-on software development experience with a track record of owning backend systems.

· Java & Spring Ecosystem: Deep proficiency in Java (Java 11/17+), Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and RESTful API engineering.

· Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure core infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI / Jenkins / GitHub Actions).

· Databases & Messaging: Strong command of SQL, database optimization, ORM tools, and event-driven architecture using Kafka or RabbitMQ.

· Full Stack Aptitude: Working knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (Angular, TypeScript) and Web Sockets for real-time user-facing features.


Core Competencies & Mindset


Ownership & Responsibility: Demonstrates a "buck stops with me" attitude toward system stability, code reliability, and timely feature completion.

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to diagnose complex concurrency, performance bottlenecks, and distributed cloud issues.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication skills to work seamlessly across architects, QA engineers, and frontend specialists.

4466851598.descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack Engineer – AEM based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to build deep expertise across the Adobe Experience Manager ecosystem while contributing to real client engagements. You will work across frontend components, backend services, content platforms, testing, and delivery pipelines. The position is designed for an engineer who already incorporates AI tools into their daily development workflow and wants to become more effective at using them responsibly. Working closely with senior engineers and architects, you will progressively take ownership of features and delivery within Agile teams. You will contribute to AEM Sites, Assets, integrations, automated testing, and modern digital experiences. The role also provides exposure to cloud-based AEM environments and evolving AI-assisted engineering practices while supporting business hours across Australia and New Zealand.

Accountabilities

  • Use AI coding assistants such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent tools as part of your daily workflow across coding, testing, documentation, analysis, and unfamiliar codebases.
  • Review, test, understand, and validate all AI-generated output before committing it, maintaining full ownership of the code you deliver.
  • Build and maintain AEM Sites components, templates, Sling Models, client libraries, and OSGi services under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Configure and support AEM Assets, including Digital Asset Management workflows and metadata-related capabilities.
  • Develop backend services using Java, Spring, OSGi, Sling, and REST APIs, including integrations with enterprise systems.
  • Build component-based frontend experiences using React JS or an equivalent modern framework while following design system and accessibility guidance.
  • Apply WCAG 2.1 AA principles when developing digital experiences and reusable frontend components.
  • Work within established Git branching, pull request, and code review practices, contributing both as an author and reviewer.
  • Ensure features successfully progress through Maven builds, CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, and automated testing, resolving failures rather than passing issues downstream.
  • Develop and maintain automated tests using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar frameworks.
  • Support security testing activities and contribute to remediation of identified findings.
  • Use AI and other engineering tools to become productive quickly when working with unfamiliar client codebases, technologies, or business domains.
  • Share useful AI prompts, context files, reusable patterns, and workflow improvements with the wider engineering team.
  • Take ownership of assigned features within each sprint while escalating architectural or design questions to senior engineers and architects when appropriate.
  • Participate actively in Agile and Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and showcases.
  • Maintain clear communication with senior engineers, architects, clients, and cross-functional stakeholders throughout delivery.

Requirements

  • 4–6+ years of experience in full stack software engineering, including at least 2 years of hands-on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) experience.
  • Demonstrated current, hands-on use of AI coding assistants such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent across code, tests, and documentation.
  • Ability to explain, review, test, and defend AI-assisted code before committing it to a production codebase.
  • Strong AEM experience covering Sites component and template development, Sling Models, HTL/Sightly, client libraries, and OSGi services.
  • Hands-on experience with AEM Assets, including Digital Asset Management workflows and fundamental metadata concepts.
  • Strong Java development skills, ideally Java 8+, together with experience in Spring and RESTful API design.
  • Experience with React JS or another modern frontend framework such as Angular or Vue, with a component-driven development approach.
  • Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and accessible frontend development practices.
  • Experience creating automated tests with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or a comparable testing framework.
  • Experience working within Agile development teams and actively participating in Scrum ceremonies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with senior engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams.
  • A proactive approach to learning, feedback, problem-solving, and communication, including the willingness to ask for support before becoming blocked.
  • Ability to work with Australia and New Zealand business hours as required.
  • Additional experience with AI context and rules files, reusable prompt libraries, MCP servers, custom agents, or automation is advantageous.
  • Exposure to AEM Headless capabilities, Content Fragments, GraphQL, structured content modeling, or Generative Engine Optimisation is a plus.
  • Experience with AEM as a Cloud Service, Cloud Manager, Dispatcher, CDN configuration, or Edge Delivery Services is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with design systems, security testing, CRM integrations, Adobe Analytics, Node.js, microservices, or other CMS and MarTech platforms is advantageous.
  • Adobe certification, such as AEM Sites Developer, and previous client-facing consulting or agency experience are considered valuable.

Benefits

  • Fully remote position based in India.
  • Full-time employment opportunity.
  • Opportunity to work on real client engagements across AEM, MarTech, AI, and digital experience projects.
  • Direct collaboration with senior engineers and architects, supporting continued technical development.
  • Hands-on exposure to AI-first software engineering practices and evolving AI-assisted delivery workflows.
  • Opportunity to deepen expertise across AEM Sites, AEM Assets, backend services, frontend development, testing, and cloud platforms.
  • Exposure to AEM as a Cloud Service and modern content delivery approaches.
  • Work supporting Australia and New Zealand business hours.
  • Progressive ownership of features and increasing responsibility as technical experience develops.
  • Opportunity to contribute ideas, reusable AI workflows, prompts, and engineering practices to the wider team.
  • Client-facing and cross-functional collaboration in a senior, hands-on delivery environment.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

4467449320.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary:

RoboMQ is a fast-growing SaaS company delivering disruptive Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions to mid-market enterprise customers. Our flagship product, Hire2Retire, automates the employee identity lifecycle by integrating HR systems with Identity Management and other applications helping organizations achieve seamless onboarding, offboarding, compliance, and security with zero-trust and least-privilege security posture.


Hire2Retire is featured in Gartner Market Guides and has been a consistent high performer on G2 in user provisioning and IAM tools.


Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan


Required experience and Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Java Development (Java 21).
  • Engineering Graduate from a premier institute.
  • Experience working with microservices using Messaging (AMQP/ RabbitMQ).
  • Experience working with MySQL or any relational database, Redis, and an understanding of data processing concepts.
  • Knowledge of web services, REST, SOAP, XML, and JSON, multithreading, and data structures.
  • Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.


Desired Skills:

It would be great if you are versed in any of these technologies:

  • Experience in software development on the Linux platform.
  • Experience of working on Cloud Technologies - AWS, Azure, Google Cloud.
  • DevOps experience, including Jenkins, build pipelines, cloud deployment, and networking concepts.
  • Experience working with Docker and a Kubernetes-based environment


Key Skills:

Java, Spring, AMQP, RabbitMQ, REST, Microservices, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Technologies - AWS, Azure, Product Design, Leadership, Strong Communication


About RoboMQ

RoboMQ is a leading API and data integration company that helps enterprises automate critical business processes to improve operational efficiency and customer experience. Our SaaS product, Hire2Retire, is a lightweight IGA solution that automates employee lifecycle management across systems like Active Directory, Azure AD, and Google Directory.

4466289148.descriptionHtml:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

SCT-Tech Enablement - Manager

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

The opportunity

We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front-end and back-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy full-stack web applications using modern front-end and back-end technologies.
  • Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Develop robust server-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
  • Design and optimize relational and non-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
  • Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
  • Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud-native development initiatives.
  • Mentor junior developers and support knowledge-sharing across teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • 6–10 years of hands-on experience in full-stack application development.
  • Strong proficiency in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
  • Experience in back-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
  • Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
  • Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
  • Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming concepts.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to serverless architectures and event-driven application design.
  • Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
  • Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test-driven development practices.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
  • Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Department: PI Germany

Position Purpose: The developer helps with the development of API-related information systems and contributes to ensuring its continuity through personal effort as part of a team or to a limited extent within the department to achieve short-term and occasionally medium-term goals.

They help in the development and realization of the software architecture as a contribution to high-quality software solutions in accordance with the applicable best practices (maintainable, safe, documented, scalable, testable and in accordance with the needs of the business area).

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

Contributing Responsibilities

  • Supporting design and implementation of internal APIs
  • Supporting co-creation with partners with technical expertise

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

  • Hands on in Spring , Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Cloud, Spring Data JPA
  • Webservices : RestFull webservcie, REST API , Hands on in openAPI/Swagger

Specific Qualifications

  • Good written and oral communication skills
  • Hands-on experience on API related activities: requirement analysis, design, resource-based API modeling, micro-services architecture

  • Microservice Architecture
  • Testing Junit & Mockito

Behavioral Skills

    • Attention to detail / rigor

Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent

Location: Chennai

4466923759.descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Java Developer with deep experience building high-quality backend applications and distributed services. You will own key modules, contribute to design and development decisions, and work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, maintainable, and scalable software.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and integrate Java-based applications and services.
  • Independently own assigned modules across the software development lifecycle.
  • Build and enhance REST-based web services and microservices for scalable application platforms.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, QA, and other stakeholders to analyze requirements and develop new features.
  • Review product functional specifications and provide practical technical feedback.
  • Follow Agile practices and SDLC processes to deliver work in a structured and predictable way.
  • Support code quality through testing, integration, review, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Contribute to performance, scalability, and reliability improvements in high-volume systems.
  • Share knowledge and support the growth of junior team members when needed.

How You Will Do It

  • Take full ownership of your modules, with accountability for quality, delivery, and long-term maintainability.
  • Stay close to the actual work by clarifying requirements early, removing blockers quickly, and focusing on what will create the most value for customers.
  • Use a disciplined Agile and SDLC approach to deliver code in small, reviewable increments and incorporate feedback continuously.
  • Apply strong Java, data structures, and algorithms knowledge to make sound design choices for performance and scalability.
  • Work as one team by collaborating openly with developers, testers, product partners, and other functions, while sharing ideas with candor and respect.

Qualifications

  • 9 -12 years of software development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Java.
  • Professional proficiency in Java 8.
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot, microservices, and REST-based web services.
  • Experience designing and developing highly scalable, distributed applications, products, or services.
  • Strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery methods and SDLC practices.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical ideas clearly.
  • BE in ECE, ETC, CSE, or ISE.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Kafka.
  • Experience with Postgres.
  • Exposure to Cloud Pub/Sub.
  • Experience with Big Data technologies.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Git.
  • Experience with performance and scalability tuning in high-volume cloud-based applications.

Farnell

Farnell, an Avnet company, is a global high-service distributor of technology products, services and solutions for electronic system design, maintenance and repair.

Job Summary

Develops, maintains, and enhances business applications. Collaborates with stakeholders to validate user requirements, assess available technologies, and recommend solution options. Assesses objectives for assigned project phases and recommends technical strategies and tactics to achieve business needs.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Uses process design technology methodologies, programming languages and tools and solutions design techniques to develop applications to meet business specifications.
  • Validates functional specifications, builds technical specifications and develops application documentation.
  • Performs analysis, design, development and testing of applications to solve business requirements.
  • Integrates new or enhanced application components.
  • Develops conversion and system implementation plans.
  • Supports change readiness initiatives as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Job Level Specifications

  • Extensive knowledge and application of principles, theories and concepts. Complete knowledge of all job functions and the broad industry best practices, techniques and standards.
  • Develops solutions to complex problems where analysis of situations and/or data requires in-depth evaluation of variables. Determine best approach to achieve results and provide suggestions to improve policies and procedures.
  • Work is performed independently and requires the exercise of judgment and discretion. Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments. Work may be reviewed at a high-level.
  • May represent the organization as a primary contact on assignments and/or projects. Interacts with senior professionals and management and frequently coordinates work between departments or organizations.
  • Actions may impact the organization. Failure to accomplish work will result in the inability to reach crucial organizational goals. Erroneous decisions may have a prolonged effect resulting in the expenditure of substantial resources.

Work Experience

  • Typically 5+ years with bachelor's or equivalent.

Education And Certification(s)

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

Distinguishing Characteristics

  • Java based CMS application frameworks experience and advantage.

4465983610.descriptionHtml:
About KeyValue


KeyValue is a premier global AI-driven product development hub, dedicated to transforming ideas into scalable and impactful software products. With expertise across diverse industries, we deliver high-quality solutions with the power of AI and automation. As an AI-first organisation, we strive to push the boundaries of technology, offering accelerated, flexible and cost-effective product development.


We have ideated, conceived, strategized and built some of the globe’s most innovative Fintech, Payments, Financial Services, Digital Commerce, Madtech, Edtech, Socialtech, Logistics, High Technology, Blockchain, Crypto, NFT and Healthcare companies, helping them conceive, scale, pivot and enhance their businesses.


KeyValue’s mission is to be the world’s most trusted product development hub – delivering high-value outcomes for start-ups & scale-ups – with a talented skilled team – in a thriving and inclusive culture.

We're looking for a Product Architect to own the technical direction of our products end to end from the first architecture decision to systems running reliably at scale. You'll set the technical bar, make the hard calls on architecture and technology and lead engineers through complex problems. Just as important: you'll be the person who spots the problem early and brings the solution, working shoulder to shoulder with product, engineering and business teams.


What You'll Do


  • Own product architecture from concept and technology choices all the way through to systems running in production at scale.
  • Translate product and business requirements into clear technical designs covering system architecture, APIs, data models, integrations and infrastructure.
  • Make and defend key architectural decisions while weighing performance, security, reliability, maintainability and cost.
  • Stay hands-on by contributing to critical design and coding decisions rather than just diagrams.
  • Catch architectural risks and bottlenecks early and drive the fixes before they become blockers.
  • Lead engineers through hard technical problems and keep architecture consistent across teams.
  • Run architecture, design and code reviews and raise the engineering bar through best practices and mentoring.
  • Evaluate AI, automation and emerging tech for real product use, focusing on signal rather than hype.


What We're Looking For


  • 6+ years of experience in building and shipping software products, with strong hands-on engineering depth.
  • Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-enabled products or working with AI-assisted development.
  • Strong expertise in software architecture, system design, design patterns and data structures and algorithms.
  • Proven experience with microservices, distributed systems, event-driven and high-availability architectures.
  • Strong in one or more backend languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, Go, Scala, or Rust.
  • Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases, API design across REST and GraphQL and system integrations.
  • Hands-on with AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native patterns.
  • Good grasp of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, testing and production reliability.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into clear technical direction and getting a team to rally behind it.
  • A sharp communicator who can explain trade-offs to engineers, product and business teams alike.

4468785381.descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Java Developer based in India.

As a Senior Java Developer, you will help shape the next generation of a cloud-based SaaS platform powering mission-critical customer experience applications. You will design, build, and operate highly available and scalable microservices running on Google Cloud Platform. The role combines hands-on Java development with deep cloud, distributed systems, and platform engineering expertise. You will contribute to modernizing existing systems while helping introduce new capabilities, including AI-powered solutions for customer service. You will work closely with an experienced engineering team in a high-performance environment where ownership and technical problem-solving are highly valued. This is an opportunity to work on large-scale cloud technology while making a tangible impact on enterprise customer experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Contribute to the development of the next generation of a SaaS platform, including AI-enabled capabilities designed to improve customer service and contact center experiences.
  • Design, develop, test, maintain, and operate highly available, scalable, and reliable microservices.
  • Apply expertise in cloud computing, software engineering, and open-source technologies to address complex platform and distributed-systems challenges.
  • Develop a deep understanding of existing applications and systems while contributing to their ongoing architecture, modernization, and evolution.
  • Build solutions that meet demanding requirements for availability, scalability, performance, security, and reliability.
  • Provide production support by investigating incidents, troubleshooting issues, and analyzing the software stack to identify and resolve root causes.
  • Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional peers in a high-performing team environment.
  • Take ownership and accountability for technical deliverables throughout the development and operational lifecycle.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement across development, deployment, testing, and cloud operations practices.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience using Java and Spring Boot.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience working with public cloud platforms, with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred; AWS or Azure experience is also relevant.
  • Practical experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, particularly Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Proven ability to design and build highly available, scalable, and reliable applications.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture and design principles, virtualization, distributed systems, load balancing, networking, event processing, large-scale data storage, and security.
  • Strong software engineering and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical challenges and develop effective solutions.
  • Experience working with production systems and troubleshooting issues across multiple layers of the technology stack.
  • Ability to understand existing architectures and contribute effectively to modernization initiatives.
  • Strong collaboration, communication, ownership, and accountability skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a distributed, multicultural, and high-performance engineering environment.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, App Engine, and Cloud SQL is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Delivery practices covering development, testing, deployment, and management on GCP is desirable.

Benefits

  • Remote work flexibility through a work-from-anywhere culture.
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Health insurance coverage.
  • Language learning opportunities and courses.
  • Relocation support and assistance where applicable.
  • Professional development through certification programs and mentorship opportunities.
  • Access to talent investment, career development, and internal mobility programs.
  • Opportunity to work on impactful technology projects for major global clients.
  • Exposure to modern cloud, AI, microservices, and distributed-systems technologies.
  • Collaborative and multicultural working environment with open communication and team-building activities.
  • Opportunity to contribute to sustainability and social-impact initiatives across areas such as IT education, community empowerment, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Technical Lead in the Technology Consulting team to work on various Guidewire implementation projects for our customers across the globe.

BE/BTech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 3 to 7 years.

  • Experience in Property & Casualty Insurance.
  • Java 5+, JEE, XML, Web Services (Axis 2), SQL, ANT
  • Strong in Pl/SQL, Spring, Hibernate, Castor, any Enterprise Messaging System
  • Should have strong knowledge and experience on Tomcat and or Websphere/Weblogic
  • Real time knowledge and experience on enterprise system integration, Preferably from Insurance domain background
  • Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices.
  • Excellent business communication skills
  • Excellent leadership skills
  • Prior Client facing experience

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in Guidewire PolicyCenter Configuration
  • Experience in Insurance domain, preferably in Property & Casualty.
  • Prior Client facing experience

4470494623.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Are you excited about working with cutting-edge technologies?

Are you a software developer who loves solving complex problems?

Join our Edge Applications Engineering Team

Our Edge Applications Engineering Team is a group of dedicated professionals shaping Akamai's aspirations to create an industry-leading digital experience.

Partner with the best

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help build features for our world class Media and Web Delivery products.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Developing business critical features for Media and Web Delivery Products
  • Assisting in making design decisions based on performance, scalability, security, and future expansion.
  • Converting high-level design specifications into low-level design and developing reusable and maintainable system software and applications
  • Collaborating with other engineering teams to identify system dependencies and complete implementations under strict product release schedules.
  • Communicating and collaborating with peers, management, architects, product and QA teams

Do What You Love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have 5+ years of relevant experience and a bachelor's degree in computer science or related field
  • Be well-versed with Java/Python programming language & have exposure to UI.
  • Possess good problem solving and analytical skills and command of data structures and algorithms.
  • Be able to design and develop secure applications that work at scale.
  • Have great systems knowledge, programming, and debugging on the Linux Environment

About Us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our Focus Is Simple

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.

Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.

AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

We are seeking 6-8 years experienced Java Full Stack Developer with strong hands-on skills in both frontend and backend technologies.

The candidate should have solid development experience using Java, JEE, Spring Boot, React, Eclipse, and be comfortable working with IBM DB2, PostgreSQL, containerization, and DevOps tools.

Candidate should be open-minded and should have willingness to learn and work on new technologies.

  • Work on frontend development using React and Eclipse/Engineering Client.
  • Build and enhance server-side components using Java, JEE, EJB, Spring Boot, and Spring Boot microservices.
  • Integrate applications with IBM DB2 and PostgreSQL databases.
  • Participate in code reviews, debugging, and performance tuning.
  • Work with Docker and basic DevOps tools for deployment.
  • Design and consume RESTful services and KAFKA for integration use cases
  • Collaborate with Agile teams and participate in PI planning and safe ceremonies

  • 4–6 years of experience as a Java Full Stack Developer
  • Strong expertise in Java, JEE (EJB), and Spring Boot

  • Experience with IBM DB2, PostgreSQL, or other relational databases
  • Knowledge of ORM frameworks (preferably OpenJPA/Hibernate)
  • Experience in REST API design, KAFKA & integration
  • Hands-on with Docker and DevOps tools
  • Proficiency in Git version control
  • Experience with JIRA & Confluence
  • Good understanding of AI/ML concepts (LLMs, model APIs, embeddings, automation use-cases)

Nice to have

  • Experience with AWS cloud
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines – GitHub Actions.
  • Testing frameworks
  • Security best practices
  • Performance monitoring & observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Opensearch, Datadog

4470674871.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join our growing team in India. In this role, you will design and build scalable backend systems, contribute to technical architecture decisions, and collaborate with global teams to deliver secure, high-performing enterprise solutions. You'll have the opportunity to work on complex projects, expand your technical expertise, and make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced consulting environment.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Design, develop, and maintain large-scale Java-based backend applications.
  • Build scalable, secure, and high-performance REST & SOAP web services.
  • Work in an agile (Scrum/Kanban) team across the full development lifecycle.
  • Develop and integrate AI/ML-driven backend services.
  • Implement cloud-native and serverless solutions on AWS.
  • Follow secure coding standards and OWASP best practices.
  • Collaborate with the Implementation Lead and global stakeholders.

Your Expertise

  • 5+ years of experience in Java backend development and Backend architecture design.
  • Strong experience building enterprise-grade, modular, and extensible systems.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Spring/Spring Boot applications, cloud, and serverless architectures.
  • Experience with AI/ML-powered backend services and LLM integrations.
  • Experience working in agile development teams.
  • Exposure to event-driven architectures.
  • .NET / C# / .NET Core development experience.
  • Experience in Oracle and MongoDB.

Why Join Westernacher?

  • Inspiring and exciting, innovative working environment.
  • Competitive remuneration package (salary, bonus, benefits).
  • International company culture and minimal hierarchical structure.
  • Chance to work on complex projects from different industries and add to your business process know-how.
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model.

This Is WE

Founded in 1969, Westernacher Consulting is a global business and SAP consulting company represented in 28 countries, with 1,400 consultants across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. As an SAP Gold Partner with over 30 years of SAP partnership experience, we combine deep industry knowledge, business process expertise, and technology innovation to create sustainable value for our clients.

We are 100% employee-owned, which shapes our entrepreneurial culture and our commitment to shared responsibility, long-term thinking and sustainable success. We work in partnership, challenge conventional thinking and give our people the opportunity to create meaningful impact for our clients, our company and one another.

Westernacher is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make employment decisions based on qualifications, experience and business needs, in accordance with applicable local law.

Life@Westernacher

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. 4470297138.descriptionHtml:
Your IT Future, Delivered

Java Developer

With a global team of 5600 IT professionals, DHL IT Services enables DHL to connect people and keep the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work globally beyond borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technological backbone of the biggest logistics company in the world. Our offices in Germany, Malaysia, Czech Republic and India have earned #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.

Digitalization. Simply delivered.

At IT Services, we are passionate about modern technologies. Our Self Service Solutions team is continuously expanding. We are looking for a Java Developer. In our diverse environment you can always grow depending on your qualification level.

We are working in an agile way. This means that our teams are completely product oriented, have end to end responsibility both for the product in development and in production. The same people not only take care of the application, but also of the business side of the product. The everyday work is typically organized using agile frameworks.

Grow together

Our mission in IT Services is “We strive for a Business Partner and Product centric organization, that lives E2E responsibility by maximizing team empowerment”. In our team we are building a team culture with proactive E2E mindset enabling us as IT Services to be a competitive advantage for the group. We are responsible for round about 20.000 lockers from DHL all over Germany.

Like our company, our team is quite global. We have technical teams located in Chennai, Prague, Darmstadt, Berlin and Bonn. To help us collaborate better, we are using tools like Teams, Jira and Confluence. You will find a nice mix of motivated people, typically geeks who are passionate about technology and who are reading about IT, even after work. But most importantly, we are a team where everyone supports each other even in tough times and where every single member tries to make things better every day.

Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for:

As a Java Developer, you must have extensive Java programming expertise and strong knowledge of the Spring or Quarkus framework.

As a technology enthusiast, you have a solid understanding of Vaadin and Jakarta EE and are proficient in Oracle Database (SQL). You work independently, prioritize effectively, and stay organized under time and workload pressure. In our multinational environment, cross-region collaboration with teams around the globe is part of everyday work, making advanced spoken and written English essential.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Take end-to-end responsibility for features from requirement refinement and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Translate customer and business requirements into robust, maintainable technical solutions.
  • Implement and enhance backend components and processes within the Packstation and Poststation environment.
  • Ensure timely delivery of software packages while maintaining high standards for quality, stability, security, and maintainability.
  • Support troubleshooting, debugging, and stabilization of production systems.
  • Take ownership of DevOps incidents, resolve production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive sustainable operational improvements.
  • Contribute to automated testing, code reviews, and engineering best practices to continuously improve software quality.
  • Share knowledge with team members and support the technical growth of the development team.


Professional Requirements:


  • More than 5 years of hands-on experience in software development, preferably in backend or enterprise application environments
  • Strong practical experience with Java, Spring or Quarkus, and Jakarta EE
  • Good knowledge of Oracle Database, SQL, REST APIs, and distributed backend systems
  • Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, automated testing, and code review practices
  • Hands-on knowledge of containerization technologies and Kubernetes in modern application environments
  • Familiarity with messaging technologies such as IBM MQ
  • Proven ability to support production systems, handle incidents, troubleshoot issues, and perform root-cause analysis in a DevOps environment
  • Solid working knowledge of monitoring and log analysis tools such as ELK or Splunk
  • Good understanding of software quality, maintainability, performance, and secure coding principles
  • Experience working in international teams, preferably in collaboration with Germany


Personal Requirements:


  • Proactive “can-do” mindset with focus on service quality, code quality, and operational stability
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to complex tasks and incidents
  • End-to-end mindset, from understanding business needs to ensuring stable production operations
  • Excellent communication, conflict resolution, and teamwork skills
  • Cultural sensitivity and strong collaboration skills in international, cross-location teams
  • Confident communication with stakeholders at different levels
  • High degree of flexibility and commitment, with a strong willingness to support the team proactively
  • Very good English skills, both written and spoken
  • An array of benefits for you:
  • Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
  • Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
  • Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
  • In House training programs: professional and technical training certification.

4469880357.descriptionHtml:
Job purpose-

The Senior Full Stack Java Engineer will design, develop, and maintain next-generation Capital Markets platforms using Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), Java microservices, Apache Kafka, and cloud-native technologies. The role will focus on building highly scalable and resilient applications supporting trade capture, lifecycle processing, workflow management, and real-time event distribution across Front Office, Middle Office, and downstream platforms.

The candidate will contribute to systems supporting FX, Rates, Swaps, OTC Derivatives, and post-trade processing workflows while collaborating with business, operations, risk, and technology stakeholders. Experience with ISDA Common Domain Model (CDM), Databricks, and enterprise data platforms will be an advantage.


Key responsibilities-

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance Java-based microservices.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant, and resilient distributed applications.
  • Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning UI, backend services, APIs, and messaging layers.
  • Build reusable frameworks, components, and libraries.
  • Participate throughout SDLC including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Develop applications utilizing Apache Kafka for event distribution and real-time messaging.
  • Build Kafka producers, consumers, and streaming solutions.
  • Implement event sourcing, idempotency, retry handling, dead-letter queues, error recovery, and event versioning.
  • Design Kafka topics, partitioning strategies, schema management, and consumer optimization.
  • Support event replay, resiliency, and high-availability requirements.
  • Develop microservices using Java 11/17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Kafka, REST APIs, and JPA/Hibernate.
  • Design and implement integrations across trading, risk, market data, and operational systems.
  • Develop secure, scalable, and performant APIs.
  • Optimize reliability and performance within distributed environments.
  • Build solutions supporting: FX Spot, FX Forward, FX Swaps, Interest Rate Swaps, Cross Currency Swaps & OTC Derivatives
  • Support trade lifecycle processing from execution through settlement.
  • Collaborate with Front Office, Risk, Product, and Operations teams.
  • Develop event-driven data pipelines feeding enterprise analytics platforms.
  • Support integrations with Databricks and data lake environments.
  • Enable regulatory reporting, risk reporting, reconciliation, trade surveillance, and operational analytics.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and lineage standards.
  • Support adoption of ISDA Common Domain Model (CDM).
  • Contribute to event and lifecycle modelling.
  • Enable standardized trade lifecycle processing and canonical business event structures.
  • Promote cross-platform data consistency.


Key competencies-


  • Strong hands-on experience in Java (Java 11/17+) development.
  • Expertise in Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Kafka, and JPA/Hibernate.
  • Experience designing and developing Microservices-based applications.
  • Strong knowledge of Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) principles.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka, Kafka Streams, and Kafka Connect.
  • Experience building Kafka producers, consumers, and stream-processing applications.
  • Strong expertise in REST API design, development, and integration.
  • Experience with distributed systems and scalable application architecture.
  • Good understanding of event sourcing, idempotency, dead-letter queues (DLQ), retry mechanisms, and event versioning.
  • Proficiency in Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, and Redis.
  • Experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools including Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, ELK Stack, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, design patterns, and Agile methodologies.
  • Experience integrating trading, risk, market data, and operational systems.
  • Exposure to Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and enterprise data platforms is preferred.

Preferred

What is the Opportunity?


This role is ideal for engineers who want to go beyond building individual components and gain a deep understanding of how enterprise platforms come together. You will play a key role in helping global banks adopt and integrate Zafin’s SaaS solutions, solving complex integration challenges across modern cloud platforms and large-scale banking technology ecosystems.

As a hands-on, customer-facing engineer, you will take ownership of delivering integration solutions from initial design through successful go-live, working closely with clients, architects, and product teams to drive business outcomes.

  • Assess and map client integration landscapes across core banking systems, APIs, messaging platforms, data ecosystems, and cloud environments.
  • Define and implement API-led and event-driven integration architectures.
  • Build and support solutions leveraging Kafka, REST services, data pipelines, and cloud technologies.
  • Partner directly with client architects, technology teams, and stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Support implementation, testing, troubleshooting, deployment, and production go-live activities.
  • Drive continuous improvement through reusable integration accelerators, best practices, and technical documentation.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by providing valuable implementation feedback to Product and Engineering teams.
  • Develop into a trusted technical advisor, guiding banking clients through complex modernization and integration initiatives.


Who We Are Looking For


Typically, 7-10 years of experience in software engineering, enterprise integration, or solution implementation.

We are particularly interested in high-performing professionals from:

  • Big 4 and technology consulting organizations.
  • Global product engineering and SaaS companies.
  • Engineering-driven enterprises with strong quality and delivery standards.


Preferred Skills & Experience


Strong expertise in several of the following areas is expected:

  • Java and enterprise application development.
  • REST APIs and API design.
  • Kafka and event-driven architectures.
  • Application and data integration.
  • Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
  • Security, networking, and distributed systems concepts.
  • SaaS platform architecture.
  • Enterprise integration frameworks and microservices-based solutions.


Additional Advantages


  • Experience integrating with banking or core banking platforms.
  • Strong academic foundation in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline from a reputable institution.
  • Demonstrated engineering excellence, problem-solving ability, and a passion for building scalable enterprise solutions.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in customer-facing environments.

Zafin is a technology company focused on helping regulated organizations modernize how critical business processes are designed, governed, and delivered. Full Stack Java Developer

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Full Stack Java Developer to join our remote team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, Redis, and modern web technologies. You will collaborate with product teams, UI engineers, and customers to build high-performance, secure, and reliable applications that support business growth.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a distributed environment, contribute to innovative products, and leverage modern cloud-native technologies while enjoying the flexibility of remote work.

  • Full-Time Employee (40 Hours/Week)

  • Flexible Working Hours

4469789012.descriptionHtml:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Technology Consulting

Title: Application Engineer - III

EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.

Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.

EY Technology:

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:

Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.

Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

The opportunity

This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.
  • Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
  • Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
  • Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
  • Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
  • Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
  • Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
  • Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
  • Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
  • Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
  • Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
  • Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
  • Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
  • Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
  • Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
  • Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
  • Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
  • Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
  • Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
  • A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
  • Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
  • Typescript

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
  • Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
  • Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
  • Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
  • Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

What We Look For

  • Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

  • Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
  • Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
  • The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Noida, Pune

Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country

Req Id: 12548

Posting Start Date: 9/23/26

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.

With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Full-Stack Developer

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Developer to design, develop, enhance, and support scalable enterprise applications. The role requires strong expertise across backend services, frontend development, API integration, and database technologies, with ownership across the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and Vue.js.
  • Build secure, reusable, and scalable REST APIs and integrate frontend components with backend services.
  • Develop and optimize data access using relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Participate in requirement analysis, technical design, estimation, code reviews, testing, release, and production support.
  • Troubleshoot defects, identify root causes, and implement reliable fixes within agreed service levels.
  • Maintain technical documentation, coding standards, source control, and deployment readiness.
  • Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, QA, DevOps, and distributed delivery teams.

Must-Have Skills And Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot development.
  • Practical experience with Node.js and modern JavaScript development.
  • Hands-on experience developing responsive user interfaces using Vue.js.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design, integration, authentication, error handling, and security practices.
  • Experience with relational databases such as Oracle or MySQL, including SQL and PL/SQL.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB.
  • Proficiency with Git or an equivalent version-control platform.
  • Strong debugging, unit-testing, and application-support capabilities.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Apache Kafka or another event-streaming platform.
  • Exposure to microservices, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms.
  • Knowledge of automated testing, code-quality tools, and application performance monitoring.
  • Experience working in Agile or distributed delivery environments.

Engagement Details: Experience: 8+ years | Location: Remote, India | Shift: Rotational/24x7 support, including on-call, weekend, and release coverage as required | Soft Skills: Strong communication, ownership, collaboration, and problem-solving.

Relocation Supported: No

Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.
