4467735101.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Job Overview:

The Lead Engineer will be responsible for implementing and maintaining Majesco Insurance products that uses ICD/ICM toolkit framework as the development framework. ICD/ICM is a Majesco's proprietary framework. Majesco has built this framework in house, using Java and many open source software. The ICD/ICM is a low code development platform which provides environment for developers to create application software through graphical user interfaces and configuration instead of traditional computer programming.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Work in Agile based self-organized team environment
  • Learn Majesco's Java based development framework and its capabilities
  • Work with Product solution architect and Business Analysts to make sure that the configuration and custom components meet application requirements and performance goals.
  • Designing of functional modules
  • Developing YAWL flows, defining and updating Object Models and Mappings
  • Writing and defining Rules in Rules Engine
  • Developing new APIs and new interfaces
  • Develop database scripting and perform data verifications

Technical Skills

Essential skills

  • Hands-on experience in designing and developing applications using Java EE platforms
  • 5-8 years of experience on JAVA
  • Object Oriented analysis and design using common design pattens
  • Good knowledge of Relational Databases, SQL and ORM technologies (JPA2, Hibenate)
  • Experience in developing web applications using at least one popular web framework
  • Experience in SOAP / RESTFul webservices
  • Experience with test-driven development
  • Good understanding of HTML5 and CSS3 and Web Standards

Behavioral Skills:

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Leading and building a strong technical team in .net technology.
  • Assertive communication skills
  • Driving change
  • Flexibility

Domain Exposure

  • Insurance Domain experience preferred

Agile/Scrum Exposure

  • Good working knowledge of Agile methodologies.

About Us:

Marriott International Inc., headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine-seat A&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 10,000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories.

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world’s largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At Marriott Tech Accelerator center (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. At Marriott Tech Accelerator, we are a team of passionate engineering minds dedicated to creating and building cutting-edge solutions that streamline operations and elevate guest experiences.

Marriott Tech Accelerator is an ANSR entity incorporated exclusively for providing services to Marriott International.


Role Title: Software Engineer

Position Summary:

Marriott is seeking a Software Engineer to join the Hotel Websites (HWS) team. This backend-focused role will contribute to Java and Spring Boot applications, REST APIs, integrations, and supporting services. The engineer will collaborate with experienced team members to implement features, troubleshoot issues, write tests, and strengthen backend engineering skills. The role primarily focuses on backend engineering while providing opportunities to contribute to integrations with CMS and digital experience platforms, including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain backend features using Java, Spring Boot, and supporting technologies.
  • Translate requirements and acceptance criteria into application logic and services.
  • Build and maintain REST APIs and integrate with databases or other systems.
  • Write readable, maintainable code that follows established team standards.
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests to support code quality and application reliability.
  • Investigate defects, review logs, troubleshoot issues, and implement fixes with team support.
  • Collaborate with AEM/CMS engineers to support digital experience platform initiatives.
  • Contribute to integrations and enhancements involving AEM/CMS platforms and backend services.
  • Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to improve code quality.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers, quality engineers, DevOps, product owners, and other team members.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
  • Support application reliability, performance, security, logging, and error handling.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing.
  • Learn and apply new backend technologies and engineering practices.
  • Demonstrate ownership of assigned work, proactively communicate risks and blockers, and contribute to a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to deployments, monitoring, and operational support of cloud-hosted applications and services.


Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of professional software development experience with Java and backend technologies.
  • Experience building REST APIs, working with relational databases, and developing microservices-based applications.
  • Hands-on experience developing enterprise applications using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Basic understanding of cloud-native application development, containerization, and deployment concepts.
  • Understanding of source control, debugging, testing, and software development practices.
  • Problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively in a team.


Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with REST API development, JSON, validation, and exception handling.
  • Exposure to Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, or similar libraries.
  • Knowledge of relational databases, SQL, and data modeling.
  • Experience with JUnit, Mockito, Postman, or similar testing tools.
  • Familiarity with Git, GitHub, Maven or Gradle, and CI/CD concepts.
  • Understanding of API security, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices.
  • Exposure to Docker, cloud platforms, microservices, messaging, caching, or monitoring.
  • Exposure to CMS or digital experience platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) is a plus.
  • Experience integrating enterprise platforms, CMS solutions, or third-party services with backend applications is preferred.
  • Understanding of Agile practices and tools such as Jira or Confluence.


What Success Looks Like:

  • Completes assigned development work with appropriate guidance and communicates blockers clearly.
  • Produces reliable, maintainable, and understandable code that follows team standards.
  • Responds positively to code review feedback and continuously develops technical skills.
  • Contributes to stable, secure, and maintainable backend services.
  • Expands expertise in backend engineering, integrations, and digital experience platforms while contributing effectively to team objectives.


Education and Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related technical field or equivalent experience/certification


Work location: Hyderabad, India.

Work mode: Hybrid

Marriott’s core values:

At Marriott, our core values make us who we are. We believe that success is never final. As we change and grow, the beliefs that are most important to us stay the same—putting people first, pursuing excellence, embracing change, acting with integrity, and serving our world. Being part of Marriott Tech Accelerator means being part of a proud history and a thriving culture.

4470122446.descriptionHtml:
Company: Shuru Tech

Website: https://shurutech.com/

Experience: 6+ Years

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


Role Overview

Shuru Tech is looking for a strong Senior Java Engineer / Java Lead with 6+ years of backend engineering experience and hands-on expertise in building document parsing and document processing systems.

This is a fully remote role where you will work on scalable backend systems responsible for ingesting, parsing, extracting, transforming, and processing data from multiple document formats including PDF, DOC/DOCX, XLS/XLSX, PPT/PPTX, HTML, XML, CSV, and scanned documents.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable backend applications and microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain document ingestion, parsing, extraction, and transformation pipelines.
  • Extract structured and unstructured information including text, tables, metadata, images, and document properties.
  • Handle formats including PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, XML, and scanned documents.
  • Work with document-processing libraries such as Apache Tika, Apache PDFBox, Apache POI, iText, or equivalent technologies.
  • Integrate OCR solutions for scanned PDFs and image-based documents.
  • Design systems capable of efficiently processing large documents and high volumes of files.
  • Build asynchronous and event-driven workflows using Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging technologies.
  • Develop REST APIs for document upload, processing, extraction, and retrieval.
  • Handle corrupted files, unsupported formats, parsing failures, and partial processing scenarios.
  • Optimize performance, concurrency, memory utilization, and processing latency.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested production-grade code.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, debugging, and production issue resolution.
  • For Lead-level candidates, mentor engineers and drive technical design and engineering best practices.

Required Skills

  • 6+ years of backend/software engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java.
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices.
  • Hands-on experience with document parsing, document ingestion, content extraction, or document processing systems.
  • Experience with libraries such as Apache Tika, Apache PDFBox, Apache POI, iText, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, asynchronous processing, and JVM performance.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Strong understanding of data structures, system design, and API design.
  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD, Git, and cloud environments.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working effectively in a remote engineering environment.

Good to Have

  • Experience with Tesseract, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, Google Document AI, or similar OCR/document intelligence platforms.
  • Experience extracting tables, layouts, forms, key-value pairs, and structured data from complex documents.
  • Experience with LLM/AI-powered document extraction or Intelligent Document Processing (IDP).
  • Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience building distributed systems capable of processing large volumes of documents.
  • Experience working in a startup or high-ownership engineering environment.

4472097039.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

We're looking for a Product Architect to own the technical direction of our products end to end from the first architecture decision to systems running reliably at scale. You'll set the technical bar, make the hard calls on architecture and technology and lead engineers through complex problems. Just as important: you'll be the person who spots the problem early and brings the solution, working shoulder to shoulder with product, engineering and business teams.

What You'll Do

  • Own product architecture from concept and technology choices all the way through to systems running in production at scale.
  • Translate product and business requirements into clear technical designs covering system architecture, APIs, data models, integrations and infrastructure.
  • Make and defend key architectural decisions while weighing performance, security, reliability, maintainability and cost.
  • Stay hands-on by contributing to critical design and coding decisions rather than just diagrams.
  • Catch architectural risks and bottlenecks early and drive the fixes before they become blockers.
  • Lead engineers through hard technical problems and keep architecture consistent across teams.
  • Run architecture, design and code reviews and raise the engineering bar through best practices and mentoring.
  • Evaluate AI, automation and emerging tech for real product use, focusing on signal rather than hype.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in building and shipping software products, with strong hands-on engineering depth.
  • Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-enabled products or working with AI-assisted development.
  • Strong expertise in software architecture, system design, design patterns and data structures and algorithms.
  • Proven experience with microservices, distributed systems, event-driven and high-availability architectures.
  • Strong in one or more backend languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, Go, Scala, or Rust.
  • Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases, API design across REST and GraphQL and system integrations.
  • Hands-on with AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native patterns.
  • Good grasp of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, testing and production reliability.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into clear technical direction and getting a team to rally behind it.
  • A sharp communicator who can explain trade-offs to engineers, product and business teams alike.

4472027966.descriptionHtml:
This is a remote position.

ShuruTech is a rapidly growing B2B IT services company specializing in building scalable, secure, and tailored software solutions for global clients. Our focus spans across CRM development, product engineering, cloud transformation, and automation. We’re passionate about empowering businesses to innovate and grow with custom technology solutions.

We are looking for a Lead Java Engineer with strong backend engineering experience and hands-on expertise in document parsing and document processing systems.
You will build scalable services responsible for ingesting, parsing, extracting, transforming, and processing information from formats such as PDF, DOC/DOCX, XLS/XLSX, PPT/PPTX, HTML, XML, CSV, and scanned documents.

  • Design and build scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Develop document ingestion, parsing, extraction, and transformation pipelines.
  • Extract text, tables, metadata, images, and structured information from different document formats.
  • Work with libraries such as Apache Tika, PDFBox, Apache POI, iText, or similar tools.
  • Integrate OCR solutions for scanned and image-based documents.
  • Build asynchronous and event-driven processing workflows using Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies.
  • Develop REST APIs for document upload, processing, extraction, and retrieval.
  • Handle corrupted files, parsing failures, unsupported formats, and partial processing scenarios.
  • Optimize systems for high-volume processing, concurrency, memory utilization, and latency.
  • Participate in system design, code reviews, debugging, and production issue resolution.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering best practices where applicable.



Requirements

  • 5+ years of backend/software engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience building REST APIs, microservices, and distributed backend systems.
  • Hands-on experience with document parsing, ingestion, extraction, or processing systems.
  • Experience with Apache Tika, PDFBox, Apache POI, iText, or equivalent libraries.
  • Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, asynchronous processing, and JVM performance.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Strong understanding of system design, data structures, and API design.
  • Experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and cloud environments.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.



Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • Remote and flexible work environment.
  • Opportunity to shape technology strategy and business outcomes.
  • Strong learning and leadership growth opportunities.

4470138763.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior Java Backend Developer

Location: Bangalore, India

Work Mode: Hybrid

Experience: 7–15 years

Employment Type: Full-time (Immediate Joiners)


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Java Backend Developer with 7–15 years of experience to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Core Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and microservices architecture.

This is a Hybrid role based out of Bangalore, suitable for someone who is technically strong, collaborative, positive, and eager to learn.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and support scalable microservices-based applications.
  • Work with Kafka for event-driven communication and messaging.
  • Develop clean, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices.
  • Write and maintain unit tests using JUnit 5 and Mockito.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and design sessions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, testers, architects, and product owners.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment and actively participate in sprint ceremonies.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and contribute to smooth build, deployment, and release processes.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues in development and production-like environments.


Required Technical Skills:

  • 7–15 years of Java backend development experience.
  • Strong understanding of Core Java concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Functional Interfaces
  • Java Streams
  • HashMap and Collections Framework
  • Multithreading and concurrency concepts
  • Experience with Spring Boot for backend service development.
  • Experience with Apache Kafka or similar messaging platforms.
  • Good understanding of microservices architecture.
  • Experience writing unit tests using JUnit 5 and Mockito.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar.
  • Good understanding of REST APIs and backend integration patterns.
  • Experience using Git or similar version control systems.


Personality and Communication Skills:

  • Positive, optimistic, and energetic attitude.
  • Willingness to contribute to a healthy team environment.
  • Comfortable communicating with team members.
  • Shows genuine interest in technology and willingness to learn.
  • Good English communication skills with a clear and understandable accent.
  • Team player with prior experience working in collaborative teams.
  • Good understanding of Agile methodology and experience working in Agile teams.
  • Open to feedback and continuous improvement.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Exposure to Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools Dynatrace/Grafana.
  • Experience with event-driven architecture.
  • Understanding of secure coding and performance optimization.
  • Preference will be given to candidates who are immediately available with experience in any of the following domains: Capital Markets, Stock Exchanges, Brokerage Platforms, Investment Banking, Wealth Management, Trading Platforms, Crypto Exchanges, FinTech, Payment Gateways, Banking

4470770723.descriptionHtml:
Senior Software Engineer – Squad Lead (Java + React)

Location: Trivandrum, Kerala (Full-time, in-office)

Experience: 8+ years

About the Role:

We're hiring a seasoned engineer to lead a squad of 10+ developers and QA engineers on a long-term enterprise engagement. You will own delivery end to end: understanding client requirements, shaping wireframes with our UI/UX team, securing client sign-off, and shipping production-grade software. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a pure management track.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional squad of 10+ engineers and QA, owning their growth, technical decisions, and delivery outcomes.
  • Engage directly with client stakeholders to elicit requirements, translate them into wireframes alongside the UI/UX team, and drive them to approval.
  • Architect and build scalable backend services in Java and Spring Boot, and modern web frontends in React.
  • Run agile ceremonies effectively (sprint planning, refinement, retros, demos) and use them to keep the squad focused, unblocked, and accountable.
  • Set and enforce engineering standards across the squad: clean code, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, observability.
  • Be the technical face of the squad to the client in design discussions, trade-off conversations, and status reviews.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep hands-on expertise in Java and Spring Boot (microservices, REST APIs, JPA, Spring Security) and React (hooks, state management, modern build tooling).
  • Proven track record of leading squads of 10+ for sustained periods, including mentoring mid and junior engineers into stronger contributors.
  • Strong experience working directly with clients in a product or services environment, including scope negotiation, demos, and approvals.
  • Comfortable collaborating with UI/UX designers to shape wireframes and validate flows before development begins.
  • Deep fluency in agile delivery and a pragmatic view on when to bend process to ship.
  • Solid grasp of cloud (AWS preferred), containers, CI/CD, and modern engineering practices.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication in English.

Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to AI-assisted development workflows (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor or similar).
  • Experience with event-driven systems (Kafka) and modern observability stacks.
  • Background working with US, UK, or UAE enterprise clients.

4470776269.title: Technical Project Manager/Lead
4470776269.description: Technical Project Manager / Lead Experience: 8 to 12 years in software delivery, with strong hands-on engineering depth and 3+ years leading a squad. Comfortable being both a delivery owner and a working technical lead. Role summary: Technical Lead who can own one module (or a tightly related module cluster) end to end, from SME clarification and user stories through development, review and module acceptance. This is a hybrid role: it runs the sprint and owns the backlog like a PM, and sets technical direction and reviews code like a lead. The lead is the human accountable for the quality and correctness of everything the squad and its AI agents produce. Key responsibilities: Own the module backlog: run SME clarification workshops, convert a near-final requirements document into clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria in Confluence, and keep that specification under change control as the build contract. Plan and run sprints for the squad (typically senior and mid engineers plus QA): estimation, sprint planning, demos, and unblocking. Set the module's technical approach within the architect's cross-module contracts: service design, data model, API and event contracts, test strategy. Direct and review AI-generated code: ensure agents work to the agreed specs, and personally gate AI output that touches finance, access control or the audit trail before it merges. Own code review standards, branch and version-control discipline, and the definition of done for the module. Drive module-level quality: unit and integration coverage, security-by-design, performance, and readiness for VAPT and UAT. Coordinate cross-module dependencies with other leads and the architects. Report progress, risks and scope-change requests for the module, supporting the program's court-reporting cadence. Must-have skills: Hands-on Java and Spring Boot, with the ability to design, review and debug microservices, not just manage them. Solid React and TypeScript understanding to guide full-stack delivery. Working command of PostgreSQL and Kafka in an event-driven design. Agile delivery leadership: backlog ownership, story writing, estimation, sprint facilitation. Strong requirements and stakeholder skills: able to run SME sessions and turn ambiguity into a frozen, testable spec. A rigorous code-review habit and the judgement to hold a quality line on AI-generated code.Location: Trivandrum, Kerala (Full-time, in-office) Experience: 8-12 years

4471030721.descriptionHtml:
Corporate Overview

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

  • The direct measurability of digital media.
  • Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
  • The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

 

Team Name: 360Finance

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)

Experience: 3+ years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable and high-performance Java-based applications.
•Build and integrate RESTful APIs with third-party systems.
•Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
•Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices.
•Troubleshoot, debug and resolve application issues to improve performance.
•Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.
•Develop unit and integration tests to ensure software quality.

Required Skills and Qualifications

•Programming: Strong proficiency in Java (version 8 or above).
•Frameworks: Solid experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Hibernate.
•APIs: Expertise in building and consuming RESTful APIs.
•Databases: Experience with relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.
•Tools: Proficient with Maven/Gradle and building tools like Jenkins or similar CI/CD pipelines.
•Testing: Familiarity with JUnit or TestNG for unit testing.
•Development Practices: Understanding of Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.

Additional Skills (Good to Have)
•Knowledge of front-end technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
•Experience with containerization tools like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
•Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
•Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).

 

QuinStreet is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, pregnancy status, sex, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristics protected by law.

Please see QuinStreet’s Employee Privacy Notice here.

4471083566.descriptionHtml:
Core java backend developer - Springboot microservice


We are seeking an experienced Core Java Backend Developer to join our team of innovators, working on a dynamic Springboot microservice. As part of our growing company, you will have the opportunity to work on high-impact projects and contribute to our reputation.

About the Role

Our team is seeking a senior Core Java Backend Developer with 6-8 years of experience to lead the development of our Springboot microservice. T

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop high-quality backend services using Java and Springboot
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate features and ensure seamless user experience
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving the overall architecture of the system
  • Collaborate with the DevOps team to ensure efficient deployment and scaling of services
  • Develop and maintain complex data models, ensuring scalability and performance
  • Analyze and resolve issues, utilizing problem-solving skills and technical expertise
  • Contribute to the development of automated testing frameworks and ensure code quality
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies, providing recommendations for improvement
  • Lead by example, mentoring junior team members and sharing knowledge with the broader team

Requirements

  • 6–8 years of Core Java backend development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Core Java.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Spring Boot.
  • Must have implemented Microservices in production (not just conceptual knowledge or maintenance).
  • Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs using Spring Boot.
  • Experience working with any SQL database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services.
  • Experience building scalable backend applications and writing clean, maintainable code.

Nice to Have

  • Mastery of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization techniques
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks
  • Knowledge of machine learning algorithms and data science principles
  • Familiarity with modern frontend technologies, such as React or Angular
  • Certifications in Java or Springboot development

4468481655.descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Java Microservices Engineer based in India.

We are seeking an experienced Java engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable distributed backend systems for enterprise applications. You will build high-performance microservices using the Java and Spring ecosystem, with a strong focus on reliability, security, and maintainability. The role involves developing APIs, integrating distributed services, optimizing databases, and supporting modern AI-enabled application components. You will work with cloud-native technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, messaging platforms, and automated CI/CD pipelines. The position offers the opportunity to solve complex distributed-systems challenges in a collaborative, agile engineering environment. Your work will contribute to resilient backend platforms capable of supporting demanding workloads and evolving business requirements.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, modular, and decoupled microservices using Java and the Spring Boot ecosystem.
  • Build enterprise-grade backend services following established software architecture principles, design patterns, security standards, and engineering best practices.
  • Develop, document, and secure high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs for communication between internal services, external applications, and AI-enabled endpoints.
  • Design resilient distributed systems using techniques such as circuit breaking, fault tolerance, rate limiting, retries, and distributed tracing.
  • Monitor and optimize application performance, scalability, availability, and resource utilization under high-volume workloads.
  • Design efficient database schemas, manage transaction boundaries, and optimize queries across SQL and NoSQL data stores.
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka and RabbitMQ.
  • Implement caching strategies using technologies such as Redis to improve application performance and reduce system load.
  • Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment and orchestration through Kubernetes.
  • Maintain and improve automated CI/CD pipelines supporting reliable build, testing, deployment, and release processes.
  • Write comprehensive automated tests using tools such as JUnit and Mockito and contribute to strong code quality and maintainability standards.
  • Collaborate with architects, product teams, developers, DevOps engineers, and other cross-functional stakeholders within agile engineering squads.
  • Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, code reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

  • 4–8 years of professional enterprise software engineering experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Java.
  • Advanced knowledge of Java 11/17+, Spring Boot, and Spring Cloud.
  • Proven experience designing and developing distributed systems and production-grade microservices architectures.
  • Strong experience building and securing REST APIs, with GraphQL experience considered valuable.
  • Practical knowledge of messaging and event-streaming technologies such as Kafka and RabbitMQ.
  • Experience with caching technologies such as Redis and an understanding of distributed caching patterns.
  • Strong database knowledge across relational SQL and NoSQL technologies, including schema design, transactions, query optimization, and data access patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application deployment.
  • Experience designing and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, clean architecture, secure coding practices, and enterprise engineering standards.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.
  • Understanding of observability and distributed-system concepts, including logging, monitoring, tracing, resilience, and performance optimization.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex backend and integration issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working within agile and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.

Benefits

  • Annual compensation of approximately INR 2,200,000–3,500,000 CTC, depending on experience and skills.
  • Full-time, mid-to-senior-level employment opportunity.
  • Remote-friendly working model with flexibility across India.
  • Location options including Bangalore, Pune, hybrid, or remote across India.
  • Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale distributed systems and modern microservices architectures.
  • Hands-on exposure to Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD technologies.
  • Opportunity to contribute to AI-enabled backend integrations and modern cloud-native application architectures.
  • Collaborative agile environment involving engineers, architects, product teams, and DevOps professionals.
  • Opportunities to work on high-throughput, resilient, and security-focused software platforms.
  • Professional development through exposure to modern engineering practices, distributed systems, and cloud-native technologies.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Experience: 6+ Years

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only

Location: Remote

Asset Collection: Mumbai / Bangalore / Chennai Office


Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Java Full Stack Developer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, RESTful Web Services, MongoDB, and front-end technologies, along with experience in CI/CD practices.

Must-Have Skills

  • Java 8+
  • Spring Boot
  • RESTful Web Services / Web Services
  • Microservices
  • MongoDB / NoSQL
  • AJAX
  • React / Angular
  • C#
  • Spring Security
  • Jenkins / CI/CD
  • Git
  • Data Structures & Algorithms

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable applications using Java 8+, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture.
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Implement effective caching strategies, exception handling, and design patterns.
  • Work extensively with MongoDB and NoSQL databases.
  • Develop and integrate front-end components using React/Angular and AJAX.
  • Implement application security using Spring Security.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, debugging, performance optimization, and technical discussions.
  • Develop and maintain automated build and deployment pipelines using Jenkins and other CI/CD tools.
  • Use Git for source code management and version control.
  • Apply strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and core computer science concepts to solve technical problems.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and provide effective, timely resolutions.

Required Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Good understanding of software development lifecycle and Agile methodologies.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a remote environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Job Location: Pune, Noida, Chennai, Hyderabad, Bangalore

Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country

Req Id: 12549

Posting Start Date: 9/23/26

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.

With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Full-Stack Developer

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Developer to design, develop, enhance, and support scalable enterprise applications. The role requires strong expertise across backend services, frontend development, API integration, and database technologies, with ownership across the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and Vue.js.
  • Build secure, reusable, and scalable REST APIs and integrate frontend components with backend services.
  • Develop and optimize data access using relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Participate in requirement analysis, technical design, estimation, code reviews, testing, release, and production support.
  • Troubleshoot defects, identify root causes, and implement reliable fixes within agreed service levels.
  • Maintain technical documentation, coding standards, source control, and deployment readiness.
  • Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, QA, DevOps, and distributed delivery teams.

Must-Have Skills And Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot development.
  • Practical experience with Node.js and modern JavaScript development.
  • Hands-on experience developing responsive user interfaces using Vue.js.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design, integration, authentication, error handling, and security practices.
  • Experience with relational databases such as Oracle or MySQL, including SQL and PL/SQL.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB.
  • Proficiency with Git or an equivalent version-control platform.
  • Strong debugging, unit-testing, and application-support capabilities.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Apache Kafka or another event-streaming platform.
  • Exposure to microservices, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms.
  • Knowledge of automated testing, code-quality tools, and application performance monitoring.
  • Experience working in Agile or distributed delivery environments.

Engagement Details: Experience: 8+ years | Location: Remote, India | Shift: Rotational/24x7 support, including on-call, weekend, and release coverage as required | Soft Skills: Strong communication, ownership, collaboration, and problem-solving.

Relocation Supported: No

Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

Zensar Technologies is a leading digital solutions and technology services company dedicated to helping organizations transform and innovate. The company prides itself on fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment, promoting continuous learning, and maintaining a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. As a global organization, Zensar Technologies operates in multiple countries, serving Fortune 500 clients and industry leaders worldwide.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Java Spring Boot Microservices Engineer to join our dynamic development team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting scalable, cloud-ready enterprise applications. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including product owners, architects, QA, and DevOps to deliver high-quality solutions that meet business requirements. The ideal candidate will have between 4 to 6 years of experience in Java development, with a strong focus on microservices architecture, REST APIs, and modern DevOps practices. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work on innovative projects utilizing the latest cloud technologies and contribute to the digital transformation initiatives of our clients.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Candidates must have 4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in Java development, specifically with Java 8 or higher versions. Proven expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, and Spring Security is essential. Familiarity with microservices architecture, REST API development, and cloud-native application deployment is required. Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, containerization tools like Docker, orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift, and CI/CD pipelines is also necessary. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in an agile environment are critical for success in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java and Spring Boot frameworks.
  • Build and optimize scalable, resilient microservices-based architectures to support business needs.
  • Create, test, and consume RESTful APIs, ensuring seamless integration with external systems and services.
  • Implement security protocols, including authentication and authorization mechanisms, to safeguard applications and data.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability through code improvements and infrastructure enhancements.
  • Collaborate effectively with Product Owners, Architects, QA, and DevOps teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical troubleshooting to maintain high-quality standards.
  • Develop automated unit and integration tests to ensure code quality and facilitate continuous deployment.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native deployment strategies, and infrastructure automation.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement solutions to prevent recurrence.

Benefits

Zensar Technologies offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance coverage, and retirement plan options. Employees have access to ongoing training and certification programs to enhance their skills and stay current with industry trends. The company promotes work-life balance through flexible working hours and remote work opportunities. Additionally, employees can participate in various wellness initiatives, employee engagement activities, and community service programs. Zensar also encourages internal mobility and career advancement, providing a platform for employees to grow within the organization and take on new challenges.

Equal Opportunity

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and drives better business outcomes. Role Summary

As a Senior AEM Developer, you will join the eCommerce Engineering team to contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of key eCommerce and internal system initiatives. In this hands-on, individual contributor role, you will leverage your expertise in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Java/J2EE, Vue.js, and other front-end technologies to deliver high‑quality, scalable solutions.

This is a Hybrid position located at our Bangalore, India development center. You will be required to be on-site 2 to 3 days per week. When you are not working on-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.

Position Details

About The Role

  • In this role, you will work independently with minimal supervision while taking ownership of complex technical problem statements.
  • You will define the technical architecture for assigned projects and ensure that proposed solutions are scalable and maintainable.
  • The position requires mentoring and guiding junior team members as needed, along with actively collaborating with architects and cross‑functional teams.
  • You will participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback, to uphold high engineering standards.
  • This role also involves interacting with peer teams across global locations and reviewing requirement documents or PRDs to analyze and implement effective solutions.
  • Strong analytical abilities are essential, as you will evaluate multiple solution approaches and identify options that ensure high performance and ease of long‑term maintenance.

About Candidate

  • The ideal candidate is an AEM Developer with 9 to 12 years of deep, hands‑on experience in Adobe Experience Manager, including AEM Cloud and versions 6.5 and above.
  • You will be responsible for coding, customizing, and extending AEM capabilities to build high‑performance, scalable, and enterprise‑grade digital platforms.
  • Strong programming expertise in Java 8+, OSGi, Sling, JCR, HTL (Sightly), along with knowledge of Vue.js, Vuex, Vue Router, and optionally Node.js, is required.
  • Experience with dispatcher configurations, caching, CDN integration, custom workflows, event listeners, schedulers, JSON, REST, GraphQL APIs, and unit testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, and AEM Mocks is expected.
  • Familiarity with Maven, Git, Jenkins/CI‑CD pipelines, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and experience in the e‑commerce domain and Copilot usage will be considered strong advantages.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills are essential to succeed in this role.

Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

  • Bonus Program
  • Pension and Retirement Plans
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Support for Community Involvement

We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

4464880093.descriptionHtml:
Summary

 Position Summary

Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.

Position Summary

 Role: Software Engineer II

Work you'll do

As a Software Engineer II on the AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend applications and application programming interfaces using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and delivery teams to analyze requirements, support solution design, and deliver features across the software development lifecycle.
  • Build and support cloud-based solutions using Amazon Web Services services and containerized deployment environments.
  • Participate in Agile delivery activities, including sprint planning, estimation, retrospectives, and peer reviews to support quality and timely delivery.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, performance improvement, defect resolution, and engineering process enhancement across project work.

The team

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST or 2 PM to 11 PM IST

Qualifications

Education: BE/BTech

Required:

  • 4-7 years of experience in Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition, Spring Boot, and microservices development.
  • Core JAVA & Backend engineering:
  • Strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8+) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
  • Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
  • Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure, and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade-offs
  • Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture, with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
  • Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
  • Experience implementing security and cloud-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud (e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
  • Strong understanding of data persistence, including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization, complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
  • Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging, including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
  • AWS Cloud
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating full stack Java applications on AWS, leveraging cloud-native services and managed platforms.
  • Experience with EC2, ECS/EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, and AWS Lambda; ability to choose appropriate compute models for Java microservices and UI-backed APIs.
  • Experience exposing and managing RESTful APIs using API Gateway and Application Load Balancer (ALB); integration with Angular/React frontends.
  • Hands-on experience with RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and DynamoDB; data modeling, performance tuning, and transactional integrity.
  • Experience implementing security using IAM, Cognito, VPCs, security groups, and secrets management via Secrets Manager / Parameter Store.
  • Experience deploying Angular/React applications using S3 + CloudFront, including CDN caching, environment configuration, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with CI/CD using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins for Java and UI applications.
  • Experience with Docker and EKS (Kubernetes) for containerized Java microservices and frontend workloads.
  • Experience with CloudWatch, centralized logging, metrics, alerts, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to diagnose production issues, optimize performance, and ensure high availability with minimal handholding.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
  • Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
  • Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
  • Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding
  • Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  • Certification (JAVA):
  • Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
  • Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Certification (AWS):
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
  • AWS Certified Developer - Associate
  • Agile Development and Collaboration
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
  • Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
  • Awareness of any of the industry domains
  • Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Spring Security, Spring Cloud, transaction management, and asynchronous communication patterns.
  • Experience with SOAP services, external application programming interface integrations, and distributed service design.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning concepts, including natural language processing, deep learning, or computer vision.
  • Experience with Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or natural language processing libraries.

#AIE2027

Our purpose

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

4430910731.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Java Developer with Cloud competencies

Department: Front & Middle Applications Domain

About Business Line/Function

Front & Middle Applications Domain manages development and applicative maintenance services and contributes to maintaining, evolving, and migrating applications towards cloud-based platforms, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with the Group’s transformation and digital strategy.

Position Purpose

As a Java Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain backend applications while contributing to cloud migration and modernization initiatives.

You will be involved in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), working in Agile teams, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and secure solutions aligned with business needs.

You will also leverage modern development practices, including AI-assisted tools, to improve productivity, code quality, and delivery efficiency, in compliance with BNP Paribas standards.

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

  • Develop andmaintainJava-based applications
  • Contribute to all Agile phases: design, development, testing, and release
  • Ensure code quality through code review, testing, and documentation
  • Support production issues and incident resolution
  • Implement and expose REST APIs and microservices
  • Contribute to cloud migration and modernization initiatives

Contributing Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with international teams (e.g., Germany partners)
  • Share knowledge and best practices within the team
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes
  • Use AI-assisted tools to support development and testing activities
  • Ensure compliance with security and development standards

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

  • Minimum 5yearsexperiencein Java development, including JEE projects and cloud migration/development
  • Solid experience in backend development (Java SE, Java EE, Spring ecosystem)
  • Experience with REST APIs and microservices architectures
  • Strong understanding of persistence frameworks (JPA, Hibernate, Spring Data)
  • Good knowledge of databases and SQL (PostgreSQL, T-SQL)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices
  • Experience with testing frameworks and code quality tools
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and collaboration skills

Specific Qualifications

  • Minimum 5years’experience in Java development
  • Experience in Agile development environments
  • Experience in cloud / microservices architectures
  • Fluent English (writtenandspoken) – mandatory

Technical Skills

Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)

  • Skill 1– Backend development: Java SE (8, 11), Java EE, Spring Boot, Spring Core, AOP, Dependency Injection (CDI)
  • Skill 2– Persistence layer: JPA (Hibernate), JTA, Spring Data
  • Skill 3– Web services: REST APIs (JAX-RS / Spring MVC)
  • Skill 4– Cloud and microservices(nice to have): Microservices architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, IBM Cloud
  • Skill 5– Development ecosystem: JBoss, SQL / PostgreSQL, T-SQL, Linux basics Build & tools: Maven, Jenkins, Sonar, Nexus Testing: JUnit, Mockito,PowerMock Version control: Git
  • Skill 6– Additional technologies (nice to have): HashiCorpVault, Terraform, Helm Charts
  • Skill 7– AI-assisted development: Familiarity with AI tools for coding, testing, and documentation Understanding of responsible and secure AI usage

Behavioral Skills

  • Skill 1 – Knowledge sharing and mentoring mindset
  • Skill 2 – Ability to promote best practices and provide functional support
  • Skill 3 – Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Skill 4 – Problem-solving mindset and ownership
  • Skill 5 – Proactive attitude and continuous learning

Education Level: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related field

Location: ISPL Chennai

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. Job Description

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.

Key team values:

  • Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
  • Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
  • Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
  • Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead

About the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.

  • Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.

  • Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).

  • Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.

  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.

  • Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.

  • Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.

  • Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.



You will be successful in this role if you:

  • Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.

  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.

  • Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.

  • Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.

  • Are able to make data-driven decisions.

  • Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.

  • Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.



Qualifications

We are looking for:

  • 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.

  • 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.

  • Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.

  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.

  • Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.

  • Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).



Technical Skills and Experience:

  • Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).

  • Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).

  • Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing.

  • Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs.

  • Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production.

  • Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms.

  • CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

  • OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking).

  • Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin).



Additional Information

What You’ll Get:

  • Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
  • Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes.

  • A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart

4469955943.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

What You'll Do

  • Build maintainable backend services using modern Java, Spring Boot, and appropriate Spring modules, following the platform’s defined architecture and standards.
  • Take ownership of the most complex features and toughest implementation problems, from implementation and automated testing through deployment and production support.
  • Read and understand existing code across services, including .NET and other languages, to understand features, data flows, and integration points and build on them effectively. Learn new languages as needed.
  • Develop reactive, non-blocking services with Spring WebFlux and Project Reactor, using practical judgment to decide when reactive programming is the right choice.
  • Implement well-designed REST APIs and, where appropriate, gRPC services, with clear contracts, validation, versioning, error handling, and backward compatibility.
  • Build event-driven integrations using Kafka and/or RabbitMQ, applying sound practices for message delivery, idempotency, retries, ordering, and dead-letter handling.
  • Model and access data in relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and NoSQL databases, apply caching effectively with Redis, and use Elasticsearch/OpenSearch for indexing and search workloads.
  • Own the process of packaging and deploying services to Kubernetes: write Helm charts, manage Kubernetes configuration (ConfigMaps, Secrets (HashiCorp Vault), health probes, resource requests/limits, HPA), and carry out safe rolling deployments.
  • Set high standards for code quality: write thorough automated tests, lead by example in design and code reviews, and mentor engineers in implementation, testing, and debugging.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and continually improve service reliability and performance.
  • Work with product, architecture, security, DevOps/SRE, and other engineering teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

Skills And Experience

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with expert hands-on coding skills.
  • Strong Java development skills: object-oriented design, collections, concurrency, asynchronous processing, and JVM fundamentals.
  • Production experience with Spring Boot and practical knowledge of Spring WebFlux/Project Reactor and reactive programming principles.
  • Proven ability to get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar codebases: trace code paths, understand existing features and conventions, and make changes that fit the established design.
  • Ability to read and understand project code in .NET and other languages, with a willingness to learn and code in any language as needed.
  • Strong API engineering skills: REST/HTTP semantics, API contracts, validation, error handling, pagination, versioning, and OpenAPI documentation.
  • Distributed-systems fundamentals: timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, rate limiting, idempotency, caching, and graceful degradation.
  • Experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ and event-driven/asynchronous communication patterns.
  • Solid relational database skills with PostgreSQL or MySQL: schema design, SQL, transactions and isolation, indexing, query optimization, and schema migrations (e.g., Flyway/Liquibase).
  • Working knowledge of NoSQL data modeling, querying, indexing, consistency, and performance. Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch is a plus.
  • Experience using Redis (or a comparable distributed cache) for caching, session state, or rate limiting, including cache invalidation and TTL strategies.
  • Strong automated-testing practices with JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, Spring Boot Test, and Testcontainers. Integration and contract testing are expected.
  • Application security fundamentals with Spring Security: TLS, JWT, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect, authentication vs. authorization, secrets management, and secure API development.
  • Hands-on Kubernetes deployment experience, including Helm: writing and maintaining charts, values management across environments, Kubernetes configuration (ConfigMaps, Secrets, readiness/liveness/startup probes, resource requests and limits), horizontal scaling, and rollout/rollback strategies.
  • Practical scripting skills in shell and/or Python for automation, diagnostics, build/deployment tasks, and developer tooling.
  • Experience with Git, Maven or Gradle, CI/CD pipelines, and production observability through structured logs, metrics, and traces (OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience with production observability tools for monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting live services. This must include at least one tool in each category: metrics/dashboards (Prometheus, Grafana), log aggregation (Splunk, ELK/OpenSearch Dashboards, Loki), and APM (New Relic, Datadog, Dynatrace, or Azure Application Insights).
  • Ability to communicate trade-offs clearly, review code constructively, and take ownership of services in production.

Nice to have

  • Microsoft Azure: AKS, Azure Service Bus / Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID, Azure Monitor / Application Insights
  • OLAP / analytics stores: BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, or Azure Synapse (analytical query patterns, partitioning/clustering, batch vs. streaming warehouse ingestion)
  • API gateways: Envoy, Kong, Spring Cloud Gateway, or cloud-managed gateways
  • Resilience libraries such as Resilience4j or comparable tools (circuit breakers, retries, bulkheads, time limiters)
