4471754335.descriptionHtml:
This is a remote position.


Experience Level: 6–8+ Years overall, with 4+ Years on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

Work Hours: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Melbourne, Australia Time)

Employment Type: Permanent Remote

Engagement: 160 hours required per month / 7.5 hours per day

Salary: Negotiable

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only (Less than 30 days)


Role Overview:

We are seeking an AI-first Senior Full Stack Engineer to own AEM builds end-to-end, frontend to backend, headless to hosted, for clients who expect senior judgement rather than a pair of hands. This role requires daily, demonstrable use of agentic AI tooling as your primary way of working, the ability to set an agent up to succeed on a real codebase, and the ability to lift the AI maturity of the engineers around you.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver every stage of your work AI-first, analysis, design, code, tests, documentation, and release notes, using agentic tooling as the default and your engineering judgement as the quality gate
  • Set up and maintain repository context and rules files, reusable prompts and skills, MCP integrations, and sub-agent patterns for the team
  • Review AI-generated output with the same rigour as human code; own what you ship regardless of what generated it
  • Design and build AEM Sites components, templates, and Sling Models across authoring and delivery tiers
  • Configure and extend AEM Assets and Content Hub, including DAM workflows and metadata schemas
  • Develop backend services in Java, integrating AEM with downstream CRM and enterprise systems
  • Deliver AEM Headless solutions using Content Fragments and GraphQL, structuring content with Schema.org markup for discoverability
  • Own delivery performance end-to-end: Dispatcher/CDN caching strategy, page weight, and Core Web Vitals against agreed budgets
  • Operate and deploy within AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS), including Cloud Manager pipelines and Dispatcher configuration
  • Own features end-to-end, from technical design through build, testing, deployment, and hypercare
  • Engage directly with client stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to AEM delivery standards, reusable patterns, and AI playbooks


Qualifications and Requirements:

  • 6–8+ years in full stack software engineering, with at least 4 years dedicated to Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
  • Demonstrable, current, daily use of AI and agentic coding tools across code, tests, documentation, and analysis, with sound judgement on where AI helps and where it must not be trusted
  • AEM Sites component and template development across frontend and backend: Sling Models, HTL/Sightly, client libraries, OSGi services, workflow models, JCR content modelling
  • AEM Assets and Content Hub, including DAM workflows and metadata governance; AEM Headless via Content Fragments and GraphQL
  • Strong core Java (Java 8+), Spring, RESTful API design; integration with CRM platforms (Salesforce or Dynamics) and Adobe Analytics
  • React JS or an equivalent framework; component-based design systems with documentation and governance; WCAG 2.1 AA applied consistently
  • AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS), including Cloud Manager pipelines, Dispatcher configuration, CDN, DNS, and environment topology
  • Test automation with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium; working knowledge of security and penetration testing
  • Client-facing consulting or agency experience; excellent written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • At least one current Adobe Certification (e.g. AEM Sites Developer, AEM Developer, or equivalent)
  • Nice to have: custom agents/MCP servers/skills you've built for a team, Edge Delivery Services, AEM Forms, Multi Site Manager/localisation, Node.js/microservices, Adobe Experience Platform tools (Target, AJO, CJA), Workfront, or other CMS/Salesforce platforms


Client Overview:

The company is a boutique Adobe-specialist, MarTech, and AI consultancy, delivering Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Data, and Digital Experience engagements for clients across financial services, government, tourism, retail, and beverages. It runs an AI-first delivery model end to end, from ticket to release note, and prides itself on senior, hands-on delivery rather than layered bench teams. Its Content Practice covers areas such as:



  • AEM Sites, Assets, and Content Hub delivery
  • AI-first, agentic software engineering
  • AEM Headless, Edge Delivery Services, and Generative Engine Optimisation
  • MarTech and CRM integrations (Salesforce, Adobe Analytics)
  • Cloud-native AEM hosting, release, and performance (AEMaaCS)

4471777723.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Location:

Bangalore,IND

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Analyze requirements, design, develop, and maintain complex software solutions.
  • Own feature development from design through implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Define software specifications, architecture, and test strategies for new features.
  • Troubleshoot complex software issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement robust fixes.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Collaborate with product management, cross-functional teams, and customers to understand requirements and manage dependencies.
  • Drive engineering best practices, technical excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications and Requirements:

  • B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in software product development.
  • Strong expertise in Core Java and modern Java features such as Streams, Functional Programming, Concurrency, and Virtual Threads.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem.
  • 4+ years of experience in software design, including HLD, LLD, OOAD, Design Patterns, SOLID, GRASP, Clean Code principles, and code reviews.
  • 4+ years of experience designing and developing Microservices or SOA-based systems.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and asynchronous distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and performance optimization.
  • Experience using AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Rovo, or similar tools to improve SDLC productivity.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites in the US, Taiwan and Korea as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Semiconductor or Metrology/Inspection domain experience.
  • Experience in UI/front-end technologies (React, Angular, etc.).
  • Experience with workflow orchestration frameworks such as Temporal, Apache Airflow, or similar platforms.

Additional Information

Time Type:

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

Yes

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. This family of products is branded MineStar. The MineStar product range links with other mining and business information systems and is an integral part of the Mining Technology Enabled Solutions vision.

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Java Developer to join our multi-disciplinary delivery teams that deliver world class mining software solutions. The Java Developer will be responsible for developing software within a high performing, self-managing and dynamic team, delivering high-value software for our enterprise customers.

  • Design, build and maintain Java-based applications and services that support Caterpillar’s MineStar ecosystem.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Quality Engineering to clarify requirements, align on acceptance criteria and incorporate feedback.
  • Support production operations by monitoring services, troubleshooting incidents, performing root-cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes.
  • Mentor and support other engineers through pairing, coaching and knowledge sharing; contribute to hiring and capability uplift as needed.

  • 7+ years of relevant commercial development experience

Skills Required

  • A commercial experience of implementing:
    • Microservices and distributed architecture
    • Modern database design and technologies

    • Build, test, and dependency management tools
    • Restful APIs
  • Java, Spring, Spring Boot, Python

  • Strong analytical, design and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage your own time and agreed priorities.
  • Experience with modern security principles and technologies

4471098170.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Java Developer with 4–8 years of experience in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining enterprise applications. The role requires hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, REST APIs, SQL, Maven, and Git. The successful candidate will contribute across the software development lifecycle, collaborate with business analysts, architects, and development teams, and deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions. The role will support business objectives through effective application development, performance optimization, production support, and CI/CD delivery practices in an Agile environment.

Required

Software Requirements

  • Java: Strong hands-on experience in enterprise application development.
  • Spring Boot: Experience developing and maintaining production-ready applications and services.
  • Microservices: Experience with microservices architecture and service-based application development.
  • REST APIs/Web Services: Experience developing, consuming, integrating, and supporting RESTful APIs.
  • Object-Oriented Programming: Strong understanding of OOP concepts.
  • Design Patterns: Practical knowledge of commonly used software design patterns.
  • Maven: Experience with build automation, dependency management, and project configuration.
  • Git: Experience with version control, branching, and collaborative development workflows.
  • SQL and relational databases: Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
  • Agile/Scrum: Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
  • Software delivery: Experience with testing, code reviews, debugging, technical documentation, and production support.

Preferred

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
  • Exposure to Banking or Financial Services domain applications.
  • Experience working on large-scale enterprise applications.
  • Experience optimizing application resource usage, performance, and infrastructure efficiency.

Overall Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance Java applications.
  • Build and enhance scalable applications using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
  • Develop, consume, integrate, and support RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Apply OOP principles and design patterns to produce maintainable and reusable software.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, architects, developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, security practices, and software engineering guidelines.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application, integration, and production issues.
  • Optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to CI/CD processes, deployment activities, release support, and production validation.
  • Prepare technical documentation and contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, estimation, planning, sprint execution, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Support effective use of application, compute, storage, and database resources through appropriate design and optimization.

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential

  • Java.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming concepts.
  • Practical knowledge of software design patterns.
  • Ability to write maintainable, testable, and reusable code.
  • Understanding of exception handling, data structures, and modular application design.

Preferred

  • Experience with scripting for automation, testing, deployment, or operational support.
  • Experience modernizing or enhancing large-scale Java applications.

Databases/Data Management

Essential

  • Strong SQL knowledge.
  • Experience with one or more relational databases, including:OraclePostgreSQLMySQL
  • Understanding of data modeling, queries, transactions, data integrity, and application data access.
  • Ability to troubleshoot database-related application issues.

Preferred

  • Experience with query optimization, indexing, and database performance tuning.
  • Experience supporting data migration, scaling, or modernization initiatives.
  • Experience designing data-access solutions for high-volume enterprise applications.

Cloud Technologies

Essential

  • No specific cloud platform is mandatory.
  • Understanding of application deployment and operational considerations in enterprise environments.

Preferred

  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience deploying and supporting Java and Spring Boot applications in cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of cloud scalability, availability, monitoring, and resource optimization.
  • Experience supporting cloud migration or application modernization initiatives.

Frameworks and Libraries

Essential

  • Spring Boot.
  • Frameworks and libraries supporting microservices development.
  • RESTful API and web service frameworks.
  • Libraries supporting relational database integration and data access.
  • Experience applying design patterns within application frameworks.

Preferred

  • Libraries supporting application security, automated testing, resilience, monitoring, and distributed communication.
  • Experience evaluating frameworks and libraries for performance, maintainability, and scalability.

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential

  • Maven.
  • Git.
  • Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Code reviews.
  • Application testing and defect resolution.
  • CI/CD process participation.
  • Debugging and production support.
  • Technical documentation and knowledge sharing.
  • Software development lifecycle practices.

Preferred

  • Docker.
  • Kubernetes.
  • CI/CD pipeline implementation and deployment automation.
  • Experience with automated quality checks, release validation, and environment management.
  • Experience with tools supporting application monitoring and operational support.

Security Protocols

Essential

  • Apply secure development practices across Java applications, Spring Boot services, microservices, REST APIs, and database integrations.
  • Protect application data, credentials, access permissions, and service integrations.
  • Apply input validation, secure configuration, access control, error handling, and appropriate data-protection practices.
  • Address security issues identified through testing, code reviews, monitoring, and production support.

Preferred

  • Experience securing cloud-based applications and microservices.
  • Experience integrating security checks into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with application security testing and vulnerability remediation.

Experience Requirements

  • 4–8 years of professional experience in Java development.
  • Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, Maven, Git, SQL, and relational databases.
  • Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise applications.
  • Experience with code reviews, debugging, production issue resolution, performance optimization, and technical documentation.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Preferred Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Preferred Experience in Banking or Financial Services.
  • Preferred Experience working on large-scale enterprise applications.
  • Candidates may also qualify through an equivalent combination of relevant professional experience, technical training, certifications, and demonstrated delivery of comparable Java and enterprise application solutions.

Day-to-Day Activities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain Java applications, Spring Boot services, microservices, REST APIs, and database integrations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, code reviews, planning sessions, testing activities, and collaboration with business analysts, architects, and development teams.
  • Deliver application features, automated tests, deployment changes, defect fixes, performance improvements, technical documentation, and production support.
  • Investigate technical issues, identify root causes, make implementation decisions within established standards, and escalate risks affecting security, quality, performance, or timelines.

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is required; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered.
  • 4–8 years of professional experience in Java development, including Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, SQL, Maven, and Git.
  • Demonstrated experience with software testing, code reviews, debugging, performance optimization, production support, and Agile delivery.
  • Certifications in Java, cloud technologies, Kubernetes, DevOps, or Agile delivery are preferred but not mandatory.
  • Maintain continuous professional development in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, cloud technologies, application security, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.

Professional Competencies

  • Apply structured critical thinking and problem-solving to diagnose application, integration, database, performance, and production issues.
  • Collaborate effectively with business analysts, architects, QA teams, developers, and other stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical concepts, implementation decisions, risks, progress, and resolutions clearly.
  • Adapt to changing requirements, technologies, project priorities, and delivery environments while maintaining software quality.
  • Identify opportunities to improve application design, automation, performance, maintainability, security, and resource efficiency.
  • Manage development tasks, testing, defect resolution, documentation, production support, dependencies, and delivery commitments effectively.

4472637318.descriptionHtml:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Opening paragraph

AEM Tech Lead is a key member of the EY Digital Experience Platform’s delivery team in GDS. This resource will use technology components from both Adobe, Microsoft and other platform components to bring to bear innovative solutions to business problems.

The opportunity

This opportunity within the EY Digital Experience Platform’s delivery team will help in the growth of your career. You will have the opportunity to work with the Adobe cloud suites and will collaborate with the broader team. Lead a team of delivery team members to provide deep technical development expertise, guidance and best practices and coding standards.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with wider technology teams and business to understand functional and non-functional requirements from a business and from a platform perspective
  • Lead a team of AEM developers & other delivery team members to provide deep technical development expertise, guidance and best practices and coding standards
  • Carry out necessary AEM development work – components, templates, services, necessary configurations
  • Conduct code reviews and technical design reviews.
  • Estimate efforts and identify technical risks and propose mitigation plan.
  • Trouble shoot production issues and provide technical guidance during critical incidents.
  • Optimize performance, dispatcher, caching strategy.
  • Document findings, learnings and recommendations
  • Share knowledge on new AEM features, capabilities, technologies, architecture methodologies, standards, leading practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

How your skills and experience will make an impact, followed by sub-headings:

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • 8 to 10 years in IT environment
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience of working with AEM
  • Hands-on development experience with AEM 6.x onwards including AEM as Cloud Service.
  • Adobe Experience Manager – components, templates, workflows, MSM and Rollout, translations and workflows, UI customisations, reporting,
  • Deep knowledge of Java, Maven, JCR, OSGI, Sling Framework, HTL (Sightly), AEM dispatchers, Restful APIs.
  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, jQuery, AJAX
  • Knowledge of Cloud Manager CI/CD pipelines, GitHub
  • Code Quality Tool/Framework: SonarQube, Junit, Mockito
  • Adobe certifications such as AEM Sites Developer and or AEM Cloud Service required

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Excellent communication skills, facilitation and influencing.
  • Understanding of the Adobe Experience Cloud suite of products.
  • Experience of Adobe’s Project Firefly highly desirable.
  • Experience of additional Adobe solutions such as a Target, Analytics beneficial.

What We Look For

  • Loves creative use of technology, likes experimentation, is not afraid to try, fail fast and learn.
  • Analytical, logical approach to problem solving.
  • Action oriented.

What Working At EY Offers

Reward statement plus an outline of the culture and environment in this part of the firm. If not covered elsewhere, this may include language about the interesting, varied and important work; the freedom and autonomy you’ll have in the role; the feedback you will receive that you can learn from to achieve mastery at something; opportunities for personal growth and career advancement; or who and how you will be connected to others.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Summary: The Senior Java Developer role focuses on integrating scalable and user-centric applications globally. The main objective is to enhance integration capabilities through advanced Java development and collaboration with various teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Architect event-driven systems with Apache Kafka for reliable processing.

  • Containerize applications with Docker and manage with Kubernetes.
  • Integrate applications with cloud platforms and establish CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement observability practices and monitoring solutions.

Key Requirements:

  • 5-10 years of experience in Java application development.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud frameworks.

  • Strong background in SQL and NoSQL databases.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Domain-Driven Design and Event-Driven Architecture.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools.
  • Knowledge of security best practices and API Gateway implementations.
  • Relevant cloud or Kubernetes certifications.

Other details:

Location: Remote

Client: Transportation / Logistics domain

Senior Backend Java Developer

Position Summary

TEGNA is looking for an experienced Senior Backend Java Developer to join our highly collaborative and agile engineering team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and building scalable backend platforms in high-performance environments. You will work on designing and developing cloud-native applications and distributed systems while collaborating across engineering teams to deliver reliable and innovative solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and AWS.
  • Build and optimize microservices-based architectures to support high-performance applications.
  • Develop reliable and scalable solutions for distributed systems operating in high-traffic environments.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver quality solutions.
  • Improve application performance, resiliency, scalability, and system reliability.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices and quality standards.
  • Drive continuous improvements through emerging technologies and modern development practices.
  • Support cloud deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence initiatives.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Java application development with strong expertise in Core Java concepts and scalable system design.
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot and related frameworks for developing and maintaining backend services.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture and distributed application design.
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) including services such as EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda.
  • Experience building and maintaining distributed systems with focus on performance, reliability, and low latency.
  • Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms and applying them to real-world engineering problems.
  • Experience working within PaaS and cloud-native environments.
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working in product companies or startup environments.
  • Exposure to modern engineering practices including CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure automation.

Why TEGNA

At TEGNA, our values guide everything we do. We Demand the Truth by delivering accurate, trusted information. We Work Smarter by finding better ways to solve problems and move quickly. We Do the Right Thing by holding ourselves to the highest standards. And We Win by working together to deliver results. If you’re ready to grow your career in corporate communications and be part of a team that lives these values every day, we’d love to hear from you.

Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.

4472397544.descriptionHtml:
Job Description – Senior Java & Node.js Backend Developer

Experience: 6–10 Years

Location: Remote

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Asset Collection: Mumbai / Chennai / Bangalore / Gurgaon

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Java & Node.js Backend Developer with 8–10 years of strong hands-on experience in backend application development, microservices architecture, API development, event-driven systems, and cloud technologies.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Microservices, Kafka, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, AWS, Docker, OpenShift, Jenkins, and API security. Experience with communication platforms such as Email and SMS is an added advantage.

The candidate should also demonstrate practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code Assist, along with an understanding of responsible AI usage, privacy, code provenance, prompting practices, and development guardrails.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance highly scalable backend services and microservices using Java 8–21, Spring Boot, and Node.js v16/v22.
  • Design and implement secure, scalable, and high-performance REST APIs, including API gateway management using Apigee.
  • Develop and manage event-driven and asynchronous architectures using Apache Kafka, AWS MSK, or equivalent messaging platforms.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain database objects, queries, stored procedures, and performance-critical operations using PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
  • Manage and enhance existing Email and SMS middleware platforms, including support, development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Work with communication platforms such as SparkPost, Twilio, Syniverse, or equivalent technologies.
  • Build and maintain containerized applications using Docker and deploy/manage workloads on OpenShift / ROSA.
  • Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Git.
  • Monitor application health, performance, availability, and logs using New Relic and ELK Stack.
  • Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, API security, and other security best practices.
  • Collaborate with internal application teams, vendors, architects, business stakeholders, and other technical teams.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a backend focus, building services in Java and Spring Boot alongside an Angular frontend. This person is comfortable moving database-centric designs toward domain-driven structures and building RESTful APIs with clean, modern patterns. Strong SQL and relational database skills are essential.

What You Will Do

  • Spend the majority of your time (approx. 70-80%) designing and implementing robust backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain the supporting Angular frontend, ensuring a seamless connection between the UI and your backend logic.
  • Lead the transition from traditional database-centric designs toward a domain-driven structure (DDD).
  • Architect RESTful APIs that prioritize proper HTTP verbs and clean, scalable patterns over legacy RPC styles.
  • Work within cross-functional squads to deliver high-quality features while maintaining the "cohesive and proactive" spirit of the team.

MUST HAVES

  • Advanced proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and a solid working knowledge of Angular, of at least 4 years.
  • A strong grasp of Object-Oriented Design (OOD) and software design patterns.
  • Deep experience building and consuming RESTful services with a clear understanding of standard API protocols.
  • Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and JPA/Hibernate. Candidates must have robust transactional database experience (Oracle, Postgres), strong SQL skills to navigate and optimize very complex SQL in KALC, and a thorough understanding of enterprise-level, high-transactional platforms. Lacking this specific database proficiency will be a direct reason for rejection.
  • A passion for server-side logic, performance, and architecture.
  • Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience working with spec-driven development or related (AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle).
  • Previous experience in the Loyalty or Fintech sectors.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and containerization (Docker).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Experience refactoring legacy structures into modern, domain-driven architectures.

Perks And Benefits

  • Remote work & Local connection: Work where you feel most productive and connect with your team in periodic meet-ups to strengthen your network and connect with other top experts.

  • Competitive Compensation in INR: Fair compensation in INR with dedicated budgets for your personal growth, education, and wellness.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About The Role

We are looking for a Tech Lead who balances hands-on backend development with team leadership. This role combines Java and Spring Boot engineering with Angular frontend work, guiding a transition toward domain-driven design and clean RESTful API architecture. You will mentor junior developers, uphold strong engineering standards, and help the squad execute with consistency.

What You Will Do

  • Act as the Squad Lead, driving the team to execute on deliverables while maintaining high engineering standards.
  • Spend a significant portion of your time designing and implementing robust backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain the supporting Angular frontend, ensuring a seamless connection between the UI and your backend logic.
  • Lead the transition from traditional database-centric designs toward a domain-driven structure (DDD), ensuring strong domain bounded contexts.
  • Architect RESTful APIs that prioritize proper HTTP verbs and clean, scalable patterns over legacy RPC styles.
  • Utilize a strong understanding of agile and software development practices to motivate the team, engage junior developers, mentor them, and help them grow.
  • Demonstrate the ability to confidently push back and say 'no' to power (be it AI or human) when advocating for best practices and architectural integrity.

MUST HAVES

  • Proven experience as a Tech Lead or Squad Lead , with a track record of motivating teams and mentoring junior developers.
  • Advanced proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and a solid working knowledge of Angular , with at least 6 years of experience .
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka .
  • A strong grasp of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOA/OOD) , software design patterns, and architectural pattern awareness.
  • Deep understanding and practical experience with strong domain bounded contexts .
  • Deep experience building and consuming RESTful services with a clear understanding of standard API protocols.
  • Experience working with relational databases ( PostgreSQL, Oracle ) and JPA/Hibernate .
  • A passion for server-side logic, performance, and architecture, coupled with good engineering practices.
  • Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience working with spec-driven development or related (AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle).
  • Previous experience in the Loyalty or Fintech sectors.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and containerization (Docker).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Experience refactoring legacy structures into modern, domain-driven architectures.

Perks And Benefits

  • Remote work & local connection: Work where you feel most productive and connect with your team in periodic meet-ups.
  • Legal presence in India: Full local compliance and structured work environment.
  • Competitive compensation in INR: Dedicated budgets for growth, education, and wellness.
  • Innovative projects: Work with modern technologies and global clients.

4474574089.descriptionHtml:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a backend focus, building services in Java and Spring Boot alongside an Angular frontend. This person is comfortable moving database-centric designs toward domain-driven structures and building RESTful APIs with clean, modern patterns. Strong SQL and relational database skills are essential.

What You Will Do

  • Spend the majority of your time (approx. 70-80%) designing and implementing robust backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain the supporting Angular frontend, ensuring a seamless connection between the UI and your backend logic.
  • Lead the transition from traditional database-centric designs toward a domain-driven structure (DDD).
  • Architect RESTful APIs that prioritize proper HTTP verbs and clean, scalable patterns over legacy RPC styles.
  • Work within cross-functional squads to deliver high-quality features while maintaining the "cohesive and proactive" spirit of the team.

MUST HAVES

  • Advanced proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and a solid working knowledge of Angular, of at least 4 years.
  • A strong grasp of Object-Oriented Design (OOD) and software design patterns.
  • Deep experience building and consuming RESTful services with a clear understanding of standard API protocols.
  • Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and JPA/Hibernate. Candidates must have robust transactional database experience (Oracle, Postgres), strong SQL skills to navigate and optimize very complex SQL in KALC, and a thorough understanding of enterprise-level, high-transactional platforms. Lacking this specific database proficiency will be a direct reason for rejection.
  • A passion for server-side logic, performance, and architecture.
  • Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience working with spec-driven development or related (AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle).
  • Previous experience in the Loyalty or Fintech sectors.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and containerization (Docker).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Experience refactoring legacy structures into modern, domain-driven architectures.

Perks And Benefits

  • Remote work & Local connection: Work where you feel most productive and connect with your team in periodic meet-ups to strengthen your network and connect with other top experts.
  • Legal presence in India: We ensure full local compliance with a structured, secure work environment tailored to Indian regulations.
  • Competitive Compensation in INR: Fair compensation in INR with dedicated budgets for your personal growth, education, and wellness.
  • Innovative Projects: Leverage the latest tech and create cutting-edge solutions for world-recognized clients and the hottest startups.

This is a remote position.


Experience Level: 6–8+ Years overall, with 4+ Years on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

Work Hours: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Melbourne, Australia Time)

Employment Type: Permanent Remote

Engagement: 160 hours required per month / 7.5 hours per day

Salary: Negotiable

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only (Less than 30 days)


Role Overview:

We are seeking an AI-first Senior Full Stack Engineer to own AEM builds end-to-end, frontend to backend, headless to hosted, for clients who expect senior judgement rather than a pair of hands. This role requires daily, demonstrable use of agentic AI tooling as your primary way of working, the ability to set an agent up to succeed on a real codebase, and the ability to lift the AI maturity of the engineers around you.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver every stage of your work AI-first, analysis, design, code, tests, documentation, and release notes, using agentic tooling as the default and your engineering judgement as the quality gate
  • Set up and maintain repository context and rules files, reusable prompts and skills, MCP integrations, and sub-agent patterns for the team
  • Review AI-generated output with the same rigour as human code; own what you ship regardless of what generated it
  • Design and build AEM Sites components, templates, and Sling Models across authoring and delivery tiers
  • Configure and extend AEM Assets and Content Hub, including DAM workflows and metadata schemas
  • Develop backend services in Java, integrating AEM with downstream CRM and enterprise systems
  • Deliver AEM Headless solutions using Content Fragments and GraphQL, structuring content with Schema.org markup for discoverability
  • Own delivery performance end-to-end: Dispatcher/CDN caching strategy, page weight, and Core Web Vitals against agreed budgets
  • Operate and deploy within AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS), including Cloud Manager pipelines and Dispatcher configuration
  • Own features end-to-end, from technical design through build, testing, deployment, and hypercare
  • Engage directly with client stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to AEM delivery standards, reusable patterns, and AI playbooks


Qualifications and Requirements:


  • 6–8+ years in full stack software engineering, with at least 4 years dedicated to Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
  • Demonstrable, current, daily use of AI and agentic coding tools across code, tests, documentation, and analysis, with sound judgement on where AI helps and where it must not be trusted
  • AEM Sites component and template development across frontend and backend: Sling Models, HTL/Sightly, client libraries, OSGi services, workflow models, JCR content modelling
  • AEM Assets and Content Hub, including DAM workflows and metadata governance; AEM Headless via Content Fragments and GraphQL
  • Strong core Java (Java 8+), Spring, RESTful API design; integration with CRM platforms (Salesforce or Dynamics) and Adobe Analytics
  • React JS or an equivalent framework; component-based design systems with documentation and governance; WCAG 2.1 AA applied consistently
  • AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS), including Cloud Manager pipelines, Dispatcher configuration, CDN, DNS, and environment topology
  • Test automation with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium; working knowledge of security and penetration testing
  • Client-facing consulting or agency experience; excellent written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • At least one current Adobe Certification (e.g. AEM Sites Developer, AEM Developer, or equivalent)
  • Nice to have: custom agents/MCP servers/skills you've built for a team, Edge Delivery Services, AEM Forms, Multi Site Manager/localisation, Node.js/microservices, Adobe Experience Platform tools (Target, AJO, CJA), Workfront, or other CMS/Salesforce platforms


Client Overview:


The company is a boutique Adobe-specialist, MarTech, and AI consultancy, delivering Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Data, and Digital Experience engagements for clients across financial services, government, tourism, retail, and beverages. It runs an AI-first delivery model end to end, from ticket to release note, and prides itself on senior, hands-on delivery rather than layered bench teams. Its Content Practice covers areas such as:

4472694526.descriptionHtml:
Company: Shuru Tech

Website: https://shurutech.com/

Experience: 6+ Years

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


Role Overview

Shuru Tech is looking for a strong Senior Java Engineer / Java Lead with 6+ years of backend engineering experience and hands-on expertise in building document parsing and document processing systems.

This is a fully remote role where you will work on scalable backend systems responsible for ingesting, parsing, extracting, transforming, and processing data from multiple document formats including PDF, DOC/DOCX, XLS/XLSX, PPT/PPTX, HTML, XML, CSV, and scanned documents.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable backend applications and microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain document ingestion, parsing, extraction, and transformation pipelines.
  • Extract structured and unstructured information including text, tables, metadata, images, and document properties.
  • Handle formats including PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, XML, and scanned documents.
  • Work with document-processing libraries such as Apache Tika, Apache PDFBox, Apache POI, iText, or equivalent technologies.
  • Integrate OCR solutions for scanned PDFs and image-based documents.
  • Design systems capable of efficiently processing large documents and high volumes of files.
  • Build asynchronous and event-driven workflows using Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging technologies.
  • Develop REST APIs for document upload, processing, extraction, and retrieval.
  • Handle corrupted files, unsupported formats, parsing failures, and partial processing scenarios.
  • Optimize performance, concurrency, memory utilization, and processing latency.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested production-grade code.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, debugging, and production issue resolution.
  • For Lead-level candidates, mentor engineers and drive technical design and engineering best practices.

Required Skills

  • 6+ years of backend/software engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java.
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices.
  • Hands-on experience with document parsing, document ingestion, content extraction, or document processing systems.
  • Experience with libraries such as Apache Tika, Apache PDFBox, Apache POI, iText, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, asynchronous processing, and JVM performance.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Strong understanding of data structures, system design, and API design.
  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD, Git, and cloud environments.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working effectively in a remote engineering environment.

Good to Have

  • Experience with Tesseract, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, Google Document AI, or similar OCR/document intelligence platforms.
  • Experience extracting tables, layouts, forms, key-value pairs, and structured data from complex documents.
  • Experience with LLM/AI-powered document extraction or Intelligent Document Processing (IDP).
  • Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience building distributed systems capable of processing large volumes of documents.
  • Experience working in a startup or high-ownership engineering environment.

4472559141.descriptionHtml:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Consulting – Banking & Capital Markets: Java Full Stack Developer

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

The Opportunity

Role Summary

We are seeking a talented and motivated Java Full Stack Developer to join our Banking & Financial Services technology team. The candidate will design, develop, test, and support enterprise-grade banking applications and digital platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong Java development skills, modern web technology experience, familiarity with API-driven and cloud-native architectures, and exposure to banking processes such as payments, lending, customer onboarding, account services, or digital banking.

Java Full Stack Developer – Banking & Financial Services

Experience - 2 To 5 Years

Domain - Banking, Financial Services, FinTech, Payments and Digital Banking

Your Key Responsibilities

Solution development

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using Java and modern front-end frameworks.
  • Build scalable microservices and REST APIs using Spring Boot.
  • Develop responsive user interfaces using Angular or React.
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Banking application development

  • Develop and enhance digital banking platforms, payment systems, lending solutions, customer portals, and workflow applications.
  • Integrate with core banking systems and third-party banking services.
  • Support regulatory and compliance-driven application enhancements.

Software engineering excellence

  • Follow coding standards, secure development practices, and architectural guidelines.
  • Perform code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Develop unit and integration tests.
  • Participate in troubleshooting and production support.

Agile delivery

  • Participate in sprint planning, estimation, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, UX teams, and QA teams.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Backend technologies
    • Java 8, 11 or 17
    • Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA and Hibernate
    • RESTful APIs and microservices architecture
  • Frontend technologies
    • Angular 12+ or React
    • TypeScript, JavaScript ES6+, HTML5 and CSS3
    • Bootstrap or Angular Material
  • Data, integration and messaging
    • Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server or MySQL, with advanced SQL skills
    • REST APIs, SOAP web services, OpenAPI/Swagger and API gateway concepts
    • Kafka, RabbitMQ or JMS
  • DevOps and cloud
    • Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Maven or Gradle, and SonarQube
    • Microsoft Azure preferred; AWS is good to have
    • Docker; Kubernetes is nice to have
  • Security and compliance
    • Spring Security, OAuth 2.0 and JWT authentication
    • OWASP principles, role-based access control and API security
    • Secure coding practices and audit logging
Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Exposure to core, corporate, retail or digital banking; lending; payments; trade finance; deposits; onboarding; treasury; or cards.
  • Experience with high-volume transaction processing, event-driven applications, real-time payments, core banking transformation, cloud migration, API modernization, or banking product implementations.
  • Familiarity with Generative AI integrations, Azure OpenAI, agentic applications, Databricks, Redis Cache, Elasticsearch, Grafana or Kibana.
  • B.E., B.Tech., MCA or M.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.

What We Look For

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Clear communication, stakeholder interaction, teamwork and knowledge sharing.
  • Ownership mindset and adaptability in Agile, global delivery environments.
  • Ability to deliver quality code with minimal supervision and translate banking processes into secure, scalable, cloud-ready solutions.
  • Practical exposure to AI models and using them to improve productivity.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

Our Commitment

As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Professional Development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

People and Culture

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

Benefits

Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Digital S/W Engineer Intmd Analyst is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the subfunction/ job family. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

We are actively seeking a motivated and talented Junior Full Stack Java Engineer coupled with an emerging AI skillset. The ideal candidate will possess hands-on experience in core technologies including Java, Spring Boot, Oracle, OpenShift, Docker, and Kubernetes. This role entails active participation in the end-to-end development, testing, and deployment of high-quality software solutions, collaborating closely with senior team members and technical leads.

Responsibilities:

  • AI-Driven Development: Utilize AI tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to enhance development efficiency, accelerate task delivery timelines, and optimize software solutions.
  • AI Landscape Awareness: Maintain awareness of the rapidly evolving AI landscape and proactively suggest innovative approaches or tools to help implement product features.
  • Execution and Collaboration: Take accountability for delivering assigned application features to successful completion. Provide support for larger project initiatives and collaborate closely with senior developers to execute design patterns.
  • Problem Solving and Troubleshooting: Demonstrate the ability to analyze and effectively troubleshoot standard coding, application performance, and design challenges.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Assist in conducting research to identify the root causes of development and performance issues, as well as implementing effective defect resolutions under senior guidance.
  • Technical Acumen: Demonstrate a solid understanding of the technical and functional requirements pertinent to the solutions under development.
  • Containerization and Orchestration: Utilize Docker for application containerization and gain experience with Kubernetes/OpenShift for service orchestration.
  • Communication and Risk Management: Effectively communicate progress, proactively flag development bottlenecks, and assist in identifying and tracking issues and risks within assigned tasks.
  • Process Optimization: Support efforts to streamline, automate, or improve build, test, and deployment processes within the immediate development team.

Requirements:

  • Proven Experience: 4 to 8 years of proven software development experience, focusing on Java, Spring Boot, Angular or React, and Oracle.
  • Modern Application Development:
    • Solid understanding of modern application architecture principles.
    • Hands-on experience (or at least awareness/theoretical knowledge of) with AI coding agents/tools like Claude Code, Devin, Replit, Cursor, Codex, etc.
    • Good working knowledge of Microservices frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot), and exposure to Event-Driven Services and Cloud-Native Application Development.
  • Full Stack Proficiency: Demonstrated capability to develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of robust web applications.
  • Front-End Development: Hands-on experience in developing intuitive user interfaces using contemporary JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Angular or React), HTML5, and CSS.
  • Back-End Development: Solid experience in developing server-side logic and REST APIs using languages such as Java, Python, or similar.
  • Database Expertise: Good working knowledge of SQL and PL/SQL, with a solid understanding of Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS), particularly Oracle.
  • API Development: Capability in building, testing, and implementing RESTful APIs leveraging appropriate frameworks and technologies.
  • CI/CD and DevOps:
    • Familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools for building (e.g., Maven, Gradle) and deploying code (e.g., Docker, Jenkins, OpenShift).
    • Experience with AWS is considered an advantage.
  • Agile Methodologies: Practical experience working within Agile development methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and utilizing project management tools such as JIRA.
  • Testing Automation: Ability to write and automate unit and integration tests (e.g., JUnit, Mockito) to ensure code quality and test coverage.
  • Version Control: Solid understanding and practical experience with code versioning tools, including GitHub Enterprise and Bitbucket.
Education:

A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field is required. An advanced degree or relevant technical certifications are considered a plus.

This is a full-time position. The successful candidate must be willing to work in UK business hours from Chennai, India.

4472177749.descriptionHtml:
About KeyValue


KeyValue is a premier global AI-driven product development hub, dedicated to transforming ideas into scalable and impactful software products. With expertise across diverse industries, we deliver high-quality solutions with the power of AI and automation. As an AI-first organisation, we strive to push the boundaries of technology, offering accelerated, flexible and cost-effective product development.


We have ideated, conceived, strategized and built some of the globe’s most innovative Fintech, Payments, Financial Services, Digital Commerce, Madtech, Edtech, Socialtech, Logistics, High Technology, Blockchain, Crypto, NFT and Healthcare companies, helping them conceive, scale, pivot and enhance their businesses.


KeyValue’s mission is to be the world’s most trusted product development hub – delivering high-value outcomes for start-ups & scale-ups – with a talented skilled team – in a thriving and inclusive culture.


We're looking for a Product Architect to own the technical direction of our products end to end from the first architecture decision to systems running reliably at scale. You'll set the technical bar, make the hard calls on architecture and technology and lead engineers through complex problems. Just as important: you'll be the person who spots the problem early and brings the solution, working shoulder to shoulder with product, engineering and business teams.


What You'll Do


  • Own product architecture from concept and technology choices all the way through to systems running in production at scale.
  • Translate product and business requirements into clear technical designs covering system architecture, APIs, data models, integrations and infrastructure.
  • Make and defend key architectural decisions while weighing performance, security, reliability, maintainability and cost.
  • Stay hands-on by contributing to critical design and coding decisions rather than just diagrams.
  • Catch architectural risks and bottlenecks early and drive the fixes before they become blockers.
  • Lead engineers through hard technical problems and keep architecture consistent across teams.
  • Run architecture, design and code reviews and raise the engineering bar through best practices and mentoring.
  • Evaluate AI, automation and emerging tech for real product use, focusing on signal rather than hype.


What We're Looking For


  • 6+ years of experience in building and shipping software products, with strong hands-on engineering depth.
  • Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-enabled products or working with AI-assisted development.
  • Strong expertise in software architecture, system design, design patterns and data structures and algorithms.
  • Proven experience with microservices, distributed systems, event-driven and high-availability architectures.
  • Strong in one or more backend languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, Go, Scala, or Rust.
  • Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases, API design across REST and GraphQL and system integrations.
  • Hands-on with AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native patterns.
  • Good grasp of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, testing and production reliability.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into clear technical direction and getting a team to rally behind it.
  • A sharp communicator who can explain trade-offs to engineers, product and business teams alike.

4474261958.descriptionHtml:
About The Company

CTeBS, a subsidiary of Classic Fashion, is a leading software solution provider to the apparel manufacturing industry globally. Our flagship product, Trendz CMP, leverages cutting-edge technology to enhance productivity, quality, and efficiency for our clients worldwide. We are in an exciting phase of growth and are looking for seasoned developers to join our engineering team.

Role Summary

We are looking for a skilled and self-driven Software Engineer to take ownership of complex features across our enterprise product suite. You will work closely with the Software Architect and Associate Technical Manager to deliver high-quality, well-tested code that meets both business and technical requirements. You will be expected to go beyond just writing code — you will contribute to technical discussions, review peers' work, and continuously improve the codebase.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and unit-test features for core modules such as the Production Planning Engine or Payroll Calculation System.
  • Translate technical design documents (TDDs) from the Architect into clean, maintainable Java/J2EE code.
  • Write optimized SQL queries and stored procedures for MSSQL/Oracle databases; analyse execution plans to address performance bottlenecks.
  • Build and maintain Angular components while adhering to the established data-flow and component-architecture standards.
  • Participate in code reviews — give constructive feedback on maintainability, security, and correctness.
  • Proactively identify and flag technical debt; propose targeted refactoring to the Architect.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues including memory leaks, slow queries, and logic defects.
  • Collaborate with QA and business analysts to clarify requirements and close gaps early in the development cycle.
  • Document technical decisions and support junior developers through pair-programming and informal mentoring.

Qualifications

  • 5 to 7 years of professional software development experience.
  • Working knowledge of Angular component architecture and RESTful API integration.
  • Proficiency in Java/J2EE — Spring Boot, Hibernate, and Multithreading.
  • Solid command of MSSQL or Oracle: stored procedures, indexing strategies, and query tuning.
  • Familiarity with OOP principles and at least a few common design patterns (Factory, Singleton, Observer).
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or GitLab) and version control (Git).
  • Exposure to Docker and code-quality tools such as SonarQube is a plus.
  • Ability to read and act on technical design documents independently with minimal supervision.
  • Good communicator who can articulate technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technical stack

Java / J2EE, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Multithreading, MSSQL, Oracle, Stored Procedures, Angular, RESTful APIs, Git, Jenkins / GitLab CI, SonarQube

Why join us

You will work on real enterprise-scale challenges in a niche industry where technology is the differentiator. Your code will be used by factories across the globe, and you will have direct exposure to both the Architect's design thinking and the broader product roadmap — accelerating your path to a senior or architect role.

4474280345.descriptionHtml:
About CTeBS CTeBS, a subsidiary of Classic Fashion, is a leading software solution provider to the apparel manufacturing industry globally. Our flagship product, Trendz CMP, leverages cutting-edge technology to enhance productivity, quality, and efficiency for our clients worldwide. We are in an exciting phase of expansion and are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to drive the technical evolution of our core enterprise engineering team.

Role Summary We are seeking an experienced, self-driven Senior Software Engineer to own, architect, and deliver complex, mission-critical modules across our enterprise product suite. In this role, you will collaborate directly with the Lead Architect and Technical Leadership to design high-throughput systems, set engineering best practices, and mentor mid-level and junior developers. You will go beyond feature implementation by actively shaping technical design, reducing system complexity, optimizing database performance, and driving overall code quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Ownership & Design: Design, and implement complex, highly scalable features for mission-critical core modules, such as the Production Planning Engine
  • Architecture & Standards: Translate high-level architectural visions and Technical Design Documents (TDDs) into robust, clean, and maintainable Java/J2EE architectures while contributing to overall technical design decisions.
  • Full-Stack Implementation: Build responsive, performant Angular UI components aligned with enterprise data-flow standards, backed by resilient Spring Boot RESTful microservices.
  • Database Engineering & Performance: Design complex schemas, write optimized SQL, and develop high-performance stored procedures for MSSQL/Oracle databases. Analyze execution plans and optimize low-performing queries.
  • Code Governance & Mentorship: Lead rigorous code reviews focused on maintainability, security, and performance. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming and architectural guidance.
  • Technical Debt & Refactoring: Proactively identify technical debt, benchmark system performance, and propose targeted refactoring strategies to the Lead Architect.
  • Production Excellence: Diagnose and resolve complex production issues, including memory leaks, thread locks, concurrency bugs, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with QA lead, Business Analysts, and Product Managers to define edge cases, clarify ambiguous requirements, and streamline the release lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 7+ years of hands-on professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale platforms.
  • Backend Mastery: Deep proficiency in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, Multithreading, and concurrent programming techniques.
  • Frontend Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Angular component architecture, state management, reactive programming (RxJS), and RESTful API integration.
  • Database Optimization: Solid expertise in MSSQL or Oracle, including advanced indexing, query tuning, stored procedures, and execution plan analysis.
  • Software Design: Advanced understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, clean architecture, and common design patterns (e.g., Factory, Singleton, Observer, Strategy).
  • DevOps & Tooling: Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation (Jenkins, GitLab CI), version control (Git), containerization (Docker), and automated code analysis tools (SonarQube).
  • Problem-Solving: Proven ability to work independently, translate high-level business goals into scalable technical solutions, and troubleshoot complex production environments.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs, risks, and design choices to both technical teams and business stakeholders.

Technical Stack

  • Backend: Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Multithreading, RESTful Microservices
  • Frontend: Angular, Typescript, RxJS, HTML5/CSS3
  • Databases: MSSQL, Oracle, Stored Procedures, Index Tuning
  • DevOps & Quality: Git, Jenkins / GitLab CI, Docker, SonarQube

Why Join Us At CTeBS, you will tackle enterprise-scale technical challenges in a niche global industry where software directly drives operational success. Your code will power manufacturing facilities across the globe. Working alongside software architects and business leaders, you will have direct influence over product architecture and team culture, placing you on a fast-track trajectory toward a Principal Engineer or Software Architect role.

4474624831.descriptionHtml:
Citi is looking for an Intermediate Software Engineer to join its Technology team and contribute to the design, development, and continuous improvement of enterprise-grade application systems. In this role, you will build and enhance full stack solutions using Java Spring Boot and Angular, working across the software development lifecycle to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable systems. You will operate with meaningful autonomy, act as a subject matter expert to senior stakeholders, and play an active role in shaping technical outcomes within a high-impact financial services environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement enhancements to enterprise application systems using Java Spring Boot and Angular, translating business and technical requirements into robust full stack solutions.
  • Develop and maintain both backend services and frontend interfaces, ensuring consistency, performance, and reliability across the full stack.
  • Analyze existing applications to identify vulnerabilities, security gaps, and areas for improvement, conducting testing and debugging to maintain system integrity.
  • Collaborate with users, clients, and cross-functional technology teams to diagnose issues and deliver effective programming solutions.
  • Apply scripting tools and code analysis techniques to define and implement system enhancements that meet evolving technical requirements.
  • Support and mentor junior analysts, sharing technical knowledge and guiding problem resolution through hands-on coaching.
  • Evaluate risk in technical decisions, ensuring development practices align with security standards, regulatory requirements, and Citi's policies.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in application development within the financial services industry.
  • Hands-on development experience with Java Spring Boot for backend services and Angular for frontend development.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical problems, evaluate options, and implement effective, well-reasoned solutions.
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely, both in writing and in conversations with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to shifting requirements in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

What We Offer

At Citi, you will join a global technology team where your work directly contributes to systems used by clients and institutions across the world. This role offers the opportunity to develop your technical craft, take ownership of meaningful engineering challenges, and grow within one of the world's leading financial services organizations.

  • A hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you flexibility alongside team collaboration.
  • Access to learning and development resources that support continuous technical growth and career progression.
  • The opportunity to work on complex, high-impact systems within a global financial services environment.
  • Autonomy to lead technical decisions and act as a subject matter expert within your team.
  • Wellbeing support and work-life balance initiatives tailored to your needs.
  • Competitive compensation and financial wellbeing benefits.

Build full stack solutions that matter — apply now to bring your Java Spring Boot and Angular expertise to Citi's global Technology team.
